title: AI Engineer / Consultant
description:
Description

AI brings huge potential, but many companies are still struggling to release the desired impact. We are a pragmatic and dynamic team to help “empower our business clients with AI”. You, as a talent, are needed to grow our business which started up from three founders with proven track-records in AI consulting and scaled AI implementations. 

 

For our powerful team, we are looking for a Swiss based AI Engineer / Consultant to develop and deliver innovative AI solutions for our customers in the German- and French-speaking regions of Switzerland.


Your mission

  • Design, implement, and deploy pragmatic AI solutions using state-of-the-art technologies, tailored to client needs and habits, to solve pressing business problems

  • Leverage AI solutions and client data to drive real-world impact and address critical business challenges

  • Work in high-performing, agile teams and play an active role throughout the project life cycle - from contributing to project proposals to designing and deploying solutions, as well as supporting business development activities

  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders across clients, partners and internal teams

  • Contribute to Artifact’s growth by developing assets and driving initiatives that support the company’s success


What you can expect

  • Work on real-world projects with Swiss clients, using the latest AI technologies and software

  • Get started right away by working on client projects starting your first months at Artifact

  • As an AI Engineer / Consultant, you will play a key role in technical consulting and implementation, particularly on external client projects. You’ll also have the opportunity to lead a project within your first year at Artifact, to grow your technical and leadership skills

  • Be involved in shaping our internal asset and strategy - your ideas and technical skills will help move Artifact forward

  • Enjoy a flexible work environment where you can grow, learn, and be part of a team that is passionate about AI


About Artifact

Artifact is dedicated to empowering people with AI for the better. As a professional service provider, we do AI and Data Science. Together, we are leveraging the best ideas to find pragmatic and sophisticated solutions with the best suited technology. We help our business clients from any sectors and any size, to accelerate their journey with AI and deliver real impact. 


Your profile

  • Experience in (Gen)AI and Data Science work with a deep understanding of Machine Learning concepts, including Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision

  • Fluency in Python, along with experience in Git, SQL, DevOps and MLOps

  • Familiarity with analytics libraries, visualization tools and Big Data frameworks, e.g. NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark

  • First experience in designing and scaling (Gen)AI solutions in production on cloud platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS or GCP), with exposure to Docker, APIs, backend/frontend development, and microservices architectures

  • Excellent written and oral communication (English and German or French is a must)

  • Enjoying communication and building relationships with clients and teams is a plus

  • Willingness to travel in Switzerland and available work permit in Switzerland

  • You intend to start your new job  at Artifact within the next 3 months from your point of application


Additional preferred qualification:

  • Experience in consulting

  • Experience in frontend engineering e.g. React

  • Experience as a full stack engineer is a plus

You’re the ideal candidate if you’re:

  • Ready to move out of your comfort zone

  • Willing to keep learning, and to stay up to date in the fast-moving field of AI

  • Open-minded and eager to learn with people with different expertise

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

About the team

We don’t build pricing models, we build the driving intelligence that feeds them. Our mission is to drive safer roads and fairer insurance through data.

The Telematics team transforms raw phone sensor data into meaningful insights about how people drive. Using advanced signal processing and machine learning, we process high-frequency data to extract behavioural signals that power our understanding of driving quality, context, and risk.

About the Role

As a Data Scientist, you’ll contribute to the future of behaviour-based insurance. You’ll contribute to the development of features and algorithms that detect driving patterns from sensors, test new hypotheses, and help bring impactful insights into production.

You’ll work closely at the intersection of data science and engineering, generating scalable, real-world insights from GPS, accelerometer, and other spatial data.

What you will be doing

  • Build and refine behavioural features and factors from telematics data.

  • Develop and maintain end-to-end pipelines in Python and SQL, ranging from simple heuristics to complex machine learning models.

  • Build robust solutions that scale, whether rule-based or ML-driven.

  • Collaborate with Software Engineers,Data Scientists, and Product Managers to implement features and evaluate their impact.

  • Run experiments, test new ideas, and assist in automating insight generation.

  • Translate complex sensor data into clear insights that can shape our roadmap and product.

What you’ll need to be successful

  • MSc or BSc in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Statistics), or equivalent practical experience.

  • Hands-on experience developing data science or data engineering solutions. You’re comfortable writing production-grade code, not just notebooks.

  • Solid skills in Python and SQL, including standard libraries (Polars, Scipy, NumPy, Scikit-Learn).

  • Experience building or maintaining data pipelines and tools that are reliable and maintainable.

  • Clear communication skills: able to break down problems into testable hypotheses and collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary teams.

  • A growth mindset: curious, eager to learn from senior peers, and open to feedback.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to noisy, high-frequency, or time-series sensor data (e.g., GPS, accelerometer).

  • Familiarity with digital signal processing or sensor physics principles.

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) and tools like Docker or basic pipeline orchestration.

  • Background or interest in insurance, mobile telemetry, or behavioural modeling.

  • Experience applying Deep Learning models to time-series data.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

Equal opportunities 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

From our headquarters in Amsterdam, we bring locker room humor and pure football passion to fans all around the world.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our team develops and maintains innovative AI solutions, including:

title: (Junior) Data Engineer | Knowledge Graphs & Pharma Data (f/m/d)
description:
Become a Part of Accurids

Join us and help make medicinal product data useful for all!

At Accurids, we build the data backbone behind life-science innovation. Our platform identifies, links and standardizes critical enterprise data in line with global standards such as the ISO standard for the Identification of Medicinal Products (IDMP), and some of the world's largest pharma companies use it to bring products to patients faster and more safely.

You will join our Services department, a group of interdisciplinary experts who help our pharma customers adopt our platform and make it truly useful for their data. Within it, you are part of the data engineering team, which works in a clear, well-documented way: state-of-the-art tools, flexible processes, and agentic AI used in a structured, reliable way. You see your results in live customer projects within weeks, and learn the pharma data domain from people who have worked in it for years.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • You transform data from a wide range of structured sources (such as CSV, JSON, RDF, and SQL and NoSQL databases) into the IDMP data model, and build the pipelines that keep it up to date.
  • You use AI to turn unstructured sources such as documents and texts into structured, verifiable data.
  • You bring a DevOps mindset to data: with AI as your everyday tool, used responsibly, you keep data flows and tooling tested, automated, documented and reliable, as the regulated pharma industry demands.
  • You support the design of data models for IDMP knowledge graphs, leveraging the IDMP ontology, and learn to navigate graphs with SPARQL and agentic tooling.
  • As part of a joint team with our customers, you work directly with their domain experts to understand their data and make their medicinal product data useful.

What helps you succeed:

  • A background in computer science, data science or a life-science subject such as biology, chemistry or pharmacy. A formal degree is welcome but not required.
  • First hands-on experience in data engineering, data transformation or data preparation.
  • You understand how software and data systems fit together and can read and judge code, whether you or an AI wrote it.
  • Experience with version control (e.g. Git) and working in a team where changes are reviewed.
  • You communicate clearly with your team and with customers.
  • You live in Germany within commuting distance of Cologne and have a valid work permit.
  • Business-fluent English. German is a plus.
  • Coding experience in any language is a bonus. What matters to us is that you understand how programs work, not which language you learned it in.
  • It's a plus if you have worked with RDF, SPARQL or knowledge graphs, have experience with AI-based information extraction, know the basics of data governance, or bring knowledge of the pharma domain and/or IDMP.

Why you’ll love working here:

  • Salary range of €50,000 to €80,000 gross per year, depending on experience
  • Hybrid work from our office in the KölnTurm with a view over the city and free parking
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Personal learning budget for trainings, conferences and certifications
  • Your choice of a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a City Plus Card with €50 per month
  • Hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux or Windows)
  • A team of around 20 people with short decision paths, where your work is visible from day one
  • A structured onboarding, together with other new colleagues starting at the same time

Not ticking every box?

Apply anyway! We care more about your potential, curiosity and motivation to learn than about a perfect checklist.

At Accurids we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented groups in tech, science and data to apply.

title: Stage 2027  Business Data Scientist - Marketing effectivness
description:
Ekimetrics est un leader mondial de l'efficacité marketing et commerciale et des solutions d'IA à l'échelle. Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability.  
 
Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services.
 
Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.  

Pourquoi recrutons-nous ?

Pour accompagner notre forte croissance, nous sommes à la recherche d’un.e Stagiaire Data Scientist avec une appétence technique et marketing/stratégie.

Notre positionnement unique sur le marché vous permettra d’allier des compétences techniques telles que l’économétrie, l’économie, les statistiques et les mathématiques appliquées avec de la programmation. Il vous permettra également de développer des compétences en stratégie, conseil et marketing afin de répondre au mieux aux problématiques business de nos clients.

Votre rôle dans l’équipe :

Votre rôle dans l’équipe : 

• Manipuler des bases de données, cleaning, avec l’utilisation d’outils adaptés  comme Python et/ou Excel. 

•  Analyser des données et réaliser des modèles  d'économétrie, statistiques bayésienne etc. 

• Analyser et construire la stratégie marketing et optimisation media en s’appuyant sur les modèles  

• Participer également à la construction des livrables et à la présentation des recommandations à nos clients  

Profil recherché : 

• Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur généraliste ou d’une école de commerce.

• Vous avez de bonnes bases en programmation, ainsi qu'une expérience en Python et avec les modèles de data science. 

• Vous savez analyser des données et les transformer en recommandations stratégiques pour répondre aux enjeux business. 

• Votre curiosité, votre esprit analytique et votre aisance en communication vous permettent de collaborer efficacement avec différentes parties prenantes.

• Une expérience académique ou professionnelle sur Databricks/Azure est un plus.

  Notre processus recrutement
  • Un test technique sur HackerRank
  • Un entretien RH avec un(e) Talent Acquisition
  • Une étude de cas
  • Un entretien final 
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
 
Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent — à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 
 
Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.
 
Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.
 
En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.
 
Nous sommes également certifiés Great Place to Work© en France, au Royaume-Uni et aux Etats-Unis, et notre bureau de Hong Kong a reçu le prix Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023©.
 
Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 !Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.  
 
Vous aurez accès :

·       A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People ;
·       De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté ;
·       Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards)
·       Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours.
 
En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes.

title: Data Engineer (w/m/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Als Data Engineer ist dein Job vielfältig und herausfordernd: Einerseits bist du Lösungsarchitekt und konzipierst in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden – vom Start-Up bis zum DAX-Konzern – moderne Datenplattformen nach aktuellen Best-Practices. Andererseits bist du Entwickler, indem du deine Ideen hands-on durch eigenen Code Wirklichkeit werden lässt.

Dein Job ist getan, wenn die Rohdaten aus den verschiedensten Quellen unserer Kunden perfekt orchestrierst, verlässlich und kostenoptimiert durch das Unternehmen fließen und so die Dashboards der Kunden stets up-to-date sind.

In unseren Projekten nutzen wir insbesondere Technologien des Modern Data Stack. Bedeutet für dich, dass du innerhalb kürzester Zeit verschiedenste Lösungen rund um Tools wie dbt, Snowflake, Databricks in allen Hyperscalern wie AWS, Azure oder GCP kennenlernen und in deiner täglichen Arbeit einsetzen wirst.

Ein Auszug aus deinem zukünftigen Alltag:

  • Du arbeitest in funktionsübergreifenden Teams – gemeinsam mit Data Engineers, Data Analysts und Business People, von uns und unseren Kunden
  • Du entwirfst und entwickelst robuste und skalierende Datenlösungen entsprechend kundenseitiger Projekterfordernisse
  • Du erstellst, optimierst und orchestrierst ELT-Prozesse, um Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen in einem Data Warehouse zu konsolidieren
  • Du hältst mit uns gemeinsam Ausschau nach neuen Technologien und Trends
  • Du hast jeden Tag ein Team hinter dir, welches dich bei allen noch so komplexen Herausforderungen entlang deiner Projekte unterstützt

Dein Profil

In unserem Team arbeitet ein Mix aus erfahrenen und neuen Personen im Data-Umfeld. Für diese Stelle suchen wir nach jemandem, der/die bereits erste Erfahrungen in der Datenverarbeitung in der Cloud sammeln konnte und dafür brennt, die nächsten Schritte auf dem Weg zum Data-Experten zu gehen.

Perfekt wird es, wenn du folgende Voraussetzungen mitbringst:

  • Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für das Thema „Daten“ und möchtest Tag für Tag in einem hochmotivierten Team neue Dinge dazulernen
  • Du trägst das „Tüftler-Gen“ in dir und machst dich selbstständig auf die Suche nach der besten Lösung für deine aktuelle Herausforderung
  • Data Warehouse, Data Lake und Data Lakehouse sind dir ein Begriff und du verfügst über Wissen in der Anwendung von Snowflake, BigQuery oder Databricks? Chapeau!
  • Du hast hands-on Expertise im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanktechnologien und in der Nutzung von performantem SQL
  • Du hast Kenntnisse in einer oder mehrerer Programmiersprachen, vorzugsweise Python, Java, Scala
  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Implementierung Cloud-nativer Infrastruktur und kennst wesentliche Konzepte wie etwa IAM, Networking, Docker – egal ob in AWS, Azure oder GCP
  • Du hast fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C2-Niveau)

Warum wir?

Aktuell sind wir 10 Mitarbeiter*innen. Bedeutet, dass du früh an Board bist und die Gelegenheit bekommst, aktiv an der Gestaltung unseres Wachstums teilzuhaben. Was wir dir noch bieten?

  • Du wirst fester Bestandteil eines super motivierten Teams im Herzen von Oldenburg!
  • Frisches Obst und Getränkeflat sind cool, besser sind ein attraktives Gehalt mit echten Aufstiegschancen. Wir bieten dir beides!
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice sind fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmenskultur.
  • Wir wollen, dass du nicht nur im Job neue Dinge kennenlernst. Mit 30 Urlaubstagen kannst du neue Länder und Kulturen bereisen. Dein Laptop bleibt dabei zu Hause!
  • 2 Workations jährlich in Dänemark und auf den Kanaren, Teamevents von Kohltour bis Weihnachtsfeier oder einfach ein gemeinsames Getränk nach Feierabend – wir lieben Unternehmungen zusammen im Team!
  • Wir statten dich mit vollem Equipment aus - für Büro und zu Hause. Neues MacBook, moderne Monitore und alle Tools, die du benötigst.
  • Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung findet nicht nur in den Projekten statt! Neben Austauschformaten zu neuesten Technologien übernehmen wir die Kosten für jedes Zertifikat, das du in Angriff nehmen möchtest.

title: Location Data engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features.

You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact.

This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems.

As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

  • Making Sense of Data

    • Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals.

    • Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams.

    • Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions.

  • Building Data Products

    • Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.

    • Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale.

    • Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models.

    • Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand.

  • Exploring & Analyzing

    • Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions.

    • Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work.

    • Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions.

    • Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result.

  • From Data to Intelligence

    • Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter.

    • Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem.

    • Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability.

    • Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production.

  • Continuous Improvement

    • Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our data infrastructure.

    • Monitor data quality and proactively investigate unexpected changes or anomalies.

    • Stay up to date with developments in data engineering, analytics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas and technologies into our stack.

    • Contribute to a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and learning.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience working with data-intensive systems.

  • Very comfortable with SQL and manipulating large datasets.

  • Experience with one or more modern data technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or equivalent tools.

  • Strong analytical skills: you enjoy digging into data, testing hypotheses, and understanding why something behaves the way it does.

  • Ability to turn exploratory analysis into reliable, production-ready data pipelines and features.

  • Familiarity with data modeling, pipeline orchestration, and large-scale data processing.

  • Ability to communicate findings clearly through metrics, visualizations, dashboards, or other tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building data products or features directly used by consumer-facing products.

  • Experience working with high-volume event, behavioral, sensor, geospatial, or time-series data.

  • Familiarity with statistics, machine learning, or feature engineering.

  • Experience taking a data problem from an ambiguous question through exploration, prototyping, evaluation, and production.

  • Experience building internal tools or visualizations for exploring and debugging complex datasets.

Life at amo

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

We chose a location in central Paris, near Opéra (Metro lines 3, 8, 9 and RER A).

We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8–9 weeks (total) per year:

  • 5 weeks of paid time off;

  • 1–2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

  • ~11 bank holidays.

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter, to allow everyone to truly recharge and avoid prolonged slowdowns. These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO.

We love the diverse perspectives we get from having people from all over the world join us (68% of our team is international), and so we of course support relocation to Paris with:

  • Help and sponsored visa process.

  • 1 month of Airbnb 100% covered by amo upon arrival.

  • Assistance from a trusted relocation agency to find your permanent home.

  • Help with French paperwork like opening a French social security account, tax forms, getting your carte vitale (free healthcare), and more.

  • French lessons to be fully set with your new Parisian life.

title: Talent Pool - Data & AI Engineer - DWH Transformation
description:
Wir suchen Data & AI Engineers zur Unterstützung bei der Migration und Modernisierung groß angelegter Data-Warehouse-Umgebungen mithilfe LLM-gestützter Workflows. Die Rolle verbindet angewandtes Machine Learning, Data Engineering und Software Engineering mit einem starken Fokus auf die Entwicklung zuverlässiger, produktionsreifer LLM-basierter Systeme für Datentransformation, Validierung und Automatisierung.

Es handelt sich hierbei nicht um eine Forschungsrolle. Der Erfolg wird daran gemessen, robuste Systeme zu entwickeln und in den produktiven Einsatz zu bringen, die reale Workflows auf Datenplattformen verbessern und automatisieren.

Wir freuen uns, Dich für zukünftige spannende Data-Engineering/LLM-Projekte in der Schweiz in unseren Talentpool aufzunehmen. Die Projekte werden sich in absehbarer Zeit weiter konkretisieren und bieten Dir die Möglichkeit, wertvolle praktische Erfahrungen im zukunftsorientierten Bereich der LLM-Technologien zu sammeln.

 

Hauptaufgaben

  • Konzeption und Entwicklung LLM-gestützter Systeme zur Unterstützung von Data-Warehouse-Migrations- und Transformationsprozessen

  • Entwicklung interner Tools und Workflows unter Einsatz von LLMs für die Generierung und Übersetzung von Datenflüssen (z.B. SQL, Spark, Flink, Kafka, dbt), Schema-Übersetzung und Datenvalidierung

  • Konzeption und Implementierung von Evaluierungsframeworks für LLM-generierte Ergebnisse, z. B. ausführungsbasierte Prüfungen, Assertions und diff-basierte Validierung

  • Aufbau und Betreuung von Datenpipelines und Orchestrierungs-Workflows in produktiven Umgebungen

  • Optimierung und Fehleranalyse groß angelegter Datenverarbeitungssysteme in verteilten Umgebungen

  • Einsatz von agentenbasierten Ansätzen und Tool-Use-Patterns, wo sinnvoll, mit Fokus auf zuverlässige und kontrollierte Ausführung

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Data Engineers und Platform Teams zur Modernisierung bestehender Legacy-Data-Warehouse-Systeme


Profil

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von ML-/LLM-basierten Produkten oder internen Tools; Erfahrung mit dem produktiven Einsatz solcher Systeme ist zwingend erforderlich.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Machine Learning oder Statistik, einschließlich Feature Engineering, Evaluierungsmethoden und Versuchsdesign.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Data-Warehouse- oder Big-Data-Systemen, z.B. Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Teradata, Oracle, Spark oder Kafka

  • Analyse von Legacy-Quellen (COBOL, SAS, JCL, DB2) mit LLM-Unterstützung; Interesse an Legacy-Code vorausgesetzt

  • Erfahrung im operativen Einsatz von Tools zur Orchestrierung von Datenpipelines, z. B. Airflow oder Dagster

  • Sehr gute SQL-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit mindestens einem weiteren Framework zur Datenverarbeitung (z.B. Spark, Flink, dbt) sowie ein gutes Verständnis der Prinzipien des Analytics Engineering

  • Erfahrung mit Best Practices im Software Engineering, insbesondere:

    • Git-based workflows

    • CI/CD pipelines

    • Infrastructure-as-code concepts

  • Vertrautheit mit LLM-Workflows:

    • Prompt Engineering

    • Verarbeitung und Parsing strukturierter Ausgaben

    • Token- und Kostenmanagement

    • Auswahl geeigneter Modelle und Abwägung von Vor- und Nachteilen

    • Entwicklung robuster Evaluierungsstrategien

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

title: Feltsense AI Engineer
description:
About the company

We raised $5.1M to build agents that operate as fully autonomous founders. Our backers include Matt Schlicht (founder of Moltbook), the founders of Crunchbase and Republic, and VCs including Draper, Precursor, and Liquid2.

We're working at the frontier of autonomous systems, building agents that don't just chat, but run entire businesses.

Our system identifies business opportunities through market signals, validates ideas with live ad tests, builds and launches software products, and brings in human experts wherever agents fall short. That loop already runs end to end: from idea to launched product to first revenue.

Over the next 12 months, our focus is on reliability, throughput, and self-improvement, making every launch better than the last.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of our autonomous agent system.

You'll lead the technical direction of the platform, building multi-agent orchestration systems, self-improving agent harnesses, and AI-powered backend services. This is a highly technical leadership role that combines architectural decision-making with hands-on engineering.

You'll be expected to ship production code, make key technical decisions, improve agent behavior in production, and help establish the engineering standards as the company scales.

Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture and make key technical decisions across the platform.

  • Design and build multi-agent systems and orchestration infrastructure that take products from idea to launch.

  • Develop self-improving agent harnesses, including feedback loops, evaluation systems, and memory.

  • Build and maintain AI-powered backend services on top of LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini.

  • Write production code, particularly around agent runtime and orchestration.

  • Debug and improve AI behavior in production through prompt engineering, structured outputs, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Break down complex technical challenges into actionable milestones and prioritize the engineering roadmap.

  • Establish engineering standards around code reviews, testing, observability, and release processes.

  • Lead and support the engineering team while remaining deeply involved in implementation.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Previous technical leadership experience at an early-stage company (Founding Engineer, Tech Lead, Head of Engineering, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks to production.

  • Experience developing self-improving or self-evolving agent harnesses.

  • Strong backend engineering skills, including designing and maintaining APIs, services, and data flows.

  • Experience working with LLM-based systems, including prompt engineering, model configuration, structured outputs, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation.

  • Daily hands-on experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools. You should know how to delegate work to agents, review their output, and verify what they build.

Nice to have

  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js experience.

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or building custom agent runtimes.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Supabase, and pgvector.

  • Familiarity with background job systems such as Inngest or Pub/Sub.

  • Experience with Zod, Vitest, and GCP Cloud Run.

  • Experience growing or restructuring distributed engineering teams.

  • Interest in AI evaluation, safety, and observability.

title: Data Analyst (No Experience Required) - Japanese and English
description:
For thousands of years, maps have provided humans with the knowledge they need to make decisions. As a Maps Evaluator, you will have the opportunity to provide ground truth for your town, city or country.

 

At Peroptyx, we are looking for Data Analysts who will review mapping data for digital mapping applications. Your research capabilities will validate and ensure that the navigation of certain routes are accurate and safe.

 

As part of this role you will verify that business names and opening hours are correct. You will check that the distance from a starting point to an end destination is listed accurately, resulting in better user experiences.

 

With this job you can plan your days around this highly flexible working schedule, work weekends or late evenings, all from the comfort of your own office. The flexibility of our roles minimizes the impact on your daily routine.

 

So, whether you are a student looking to earn as you learn, a retiree looking for a new challenge, a part-time/full time professional or a work from home parent, Peroptyx has the right role for you!

 

Benefits

  • Work up to 20 hours per week.

  • Earn a competitive rate of pay.

  • Develop your research skills.

  • Avoid the long commute.

  • Work from the comfort of your home office.

  • Enjoy the flexibility of setting your own working hours!

 

Ideal Candidate

  • Fluent in English and Japanese.

  • Excellent research skills.

  • Excellent local knowledge of your home country.

  • Good understanding and general knowledge of the geography and culture of Japan.

  • Analytical mindset.

 

Job Requirements

  • Must be living in Japan for a minimum of 5 consecutive years.

  • Must pass an online open-book exam that can verify your full understanding of the material and concepts.

  • Must be willing to work a minimum of 10 hours and up to 20 hours per week depending on task availability.

  • Good working knowledge of search engines, map applications and familiarity with social media platforms.

  • Strong ability to learn, understand and apply multiple sets of different instructions.

  • All work must be of an independent nature.

 

Apply Online Today!

title: SAS Data Analyst (UK)
description:
Celerion is committed to swift, exceptional clinical research through translational medicine.  Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get drugs to market faster.  Celerion offers one of the most experienced clinical pharmacology research networks in the industry.
 
Are you looking for an opportunity to support a business creating life-saving treatments? If so, we can't wait to meet you!
Celerion is seeking a full-time experienced SAS Data Analyst to join our Data Management and Biometrics team in Belfast, Northern Ireland and provide SAS statistical support to the project team for analysis and reporting of clinical data in early stage clinical research studies.
 
The primary responsibilities of this position are:
- independently develop, maintain, and process SAS programs for moderately complex studies that create standard and/or customized: edits to clinical checks, analytical data sets, statistical analyses, tables, figures, and electronic data transfers
-assist Senior SAS Data Analysts and Biostatisticians with highly complex projects and perform peer Quality Control functions for output using data from studies with similar characteristics
-also responsible for ensuring strict compliance with study protocol and department procedures
 
An attractive salary and benefits package is available.
 

Education and skills requirements
  • We require a Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematical Science or Physics OR an advanced degree in Statistics OR equivalent related pharmaceutical industry SAS programming experience. 
  • Additionally, we require excellent interpersonal skills, ability to work with a team and demonstrated problem-solving skills.
  • Salary will be based on skills and experience. An attractive benefits package including pension, life assurance, permanent health insurance, private medical insurance and holidays is provided.
  • This role will be office-based at our Belfast, Northern Ireland facility.  It is not a home-based role.  Candidates must be already living and able to work in the UK and able to relocate to Belfast, Northern Ireland if not already resident.

    Celerion is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Backend Engineer (Go)
description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

What will you be doing?

  • Building and scaling a distributed system using Go, DynamoDB, SQS, Redshift and Lambdas

  • Building a snappy full-stack app using cutting-edge tech (including Next on Vercel, gRPC)

  • Working on the next version of the Prelude API, which we strive to be industry-leading in terms of usability, performance and functionality

  • Ensuring that our services are scalable, extensible, reliable, and performant

  • Helping deploy and scale our fraud prevention model to hundreds of large customers

  • Developing and maintaining internal tools to improve developer efficiency

  • Interacting with clients on a daily basis to assist them and build features around their needs

  • Participating in on-call rotations to guarantee the stability and reliability of our APIs

What are we looking for?

  • Experience designing and engineering large-scale systems

  • Strong coding skills in Go - any experience with Rust, TypeScript or similar is a huge plus

  • A preference for simplicity vs complexity, with intuition for what will scale effectively

  • A product led mindset, keen to code for the output and the impact

  • Fluent/professional English given our international team

What can we offer you?

  • Competitive compensation package with BSPCEs

  • 3 days in-office in central Paris, with 2 days WFH; and 4 weeks of remote work per year

  • 100% travel to the office subsidised

  • Health insurance via Alan

  • Urban Sports Club gym membership

  • We will provide you with the gear you need for your role (a laptop and a phone, for on-call rotations)

  • Swile meal vouchers

  • Free snacks and drinks in the office

  • An annual offsite in great locations

  • The opportunity to build something from 0-1, and make an impact every day

Interview process

  • Meet a member of the Talent team

  • Technical interview

  • In person interview (system design, coding)

  • Final meeting with CEO

Compensation: €60K – €65K • Offers Equity

title: Confirmed Backend Engineer - Care
description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip.

BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions.

In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions.


We are looking for a Confirmed Backend Engineer to join the Care team at BlaBlaCar.

As part of the Corporate Services pillar, your mission will be to empower our Community Relations Team (CRT) with the tools they need to have a 360-degree view of the user journey across our platform. 

The Care team's primary objective is to build "Phoenix," our new, comprehensive back-office system. This service aggregates data from all other teams and supply lines (train, carpool, and bus), while also providing critical action capabilities regarding our users, such as account blocking and content moderation. 

Your role will be to contribute to the creation of this unified back-office and to ensure our customer relation agents can operate seamlessly. 

You will work within a multi-stack team of 3 Backend & 1 Frontend Engineer. You will collaborate closely with the Community Relations Team (CRT) as well as with Product Managers from other teams to best define needs and ensure seamless integration across the company.



Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and evolve the services of the BlaBlaCar Backoffice

  • Maintain some strategic user features like the claim management and reporting systems of the BlaBlaCar platform

  • Take full ownership of substantial features, from technical design and implementation to deployment and monitoring

  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and other engineers to refine requirements and translate business needs into robust technical solutions

  • Uphold and improve the team's code quality standards, providing detailed feedback and mentorship through code reviews

  • Document the solutions we build and ensure our APIs and services are well understood by consumer teams


    • Your Qualifications

  • You have solid experience from companies with a strong engineering culture, within a growth context

  • You have a solid knowledge of the Java language and ecosystem, and have good foundations in software architecture

  • You have hands-on experience with Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and monitoring solutions (Datadog)

  • You have significant experience building, deploying, and operating Backend microservices in a production environment

  • You value a product-oriented mindset and are focused on delivering business impact when designing software

  • You feel comfortable making technical choices and balancing business needs with technical constraints

    • If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you'd still be a great fit for this role in your application!


    What we have to offer

  • Hybrid position : 2 days at the office per week 

  • 50% healthcare coverage (Alan)

  • 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves

  • Financial support for home office equipment

  • Minimum 25 days holiday per year 

  • Local meal plan policy (Swile card)

  • 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable)

  • Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides

  • Personal growth via trainings, mentorship, and internal mobility programs

  • Employee Stock ownership plan

  • Regular team building events

  • 1 day off per year to test our product


    • Interested in joining the ride?

  • a 45-min video-call with Chloé, Talent Acquisition Manager, to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions

  • a 60-min video-call with Rémi, Engineering Manager, to discuss your experience and share more details about the squad

  • a 90-min live coding session with Software Engineers

  • a 60-min design interview with Software Engineers

  • a 30-min video-call with Camille, Head Of Corporate Services, for vision fit and rounding off the process

    • BlaBlaCar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Software Engineer
description:
ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science

Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET

About Claims

AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.

We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.

The team

Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.

  • Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
  • Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
  • Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer.

Our culture

We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust.

About the role

Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack)
Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time.
Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation.

This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain.

You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, command-line tools, and background processing workflows.
  • Develop and improve web dashboards and internal review tools using TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks.
  • Maintain pipelines that ingest research papers, process documents, extract structured information, and evaluate results.
  • Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs.
  • Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks.
  • Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage.
  • Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review.
  • Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software.

Required skills and experience

  • Typically 1â5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software.
  • Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests.
  • Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting HTTP APIs, with a sound understanding of JSON, validation, authentication, and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework.
  • Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries.
  • Confidence working in Linux environments and using the command line to investigate logs, configuration, processes, and service failures.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • An understanding of secure engineering practices, including access controls, secrets management, and careful handling of private data.
  • The ability to navigate an existing codebase, trace issues across components, and make focused, well-tested changes.
  • Clear communication, practical problem-solving, and the judgment to work independently while asking for input when requirements or risks are unclear.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, building AI-assisted workflows, or evaluating model outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Familiarity with PDF parsing, OCR, document extraction, scientific datasets, or evidence provenance.
  • Experience with distributed jobs, asynchronous processing, reproducible pipelines, or automated benchmarking.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, systemd, GitHub Actions, cloud hosting, or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with Bittensor, decentralized compute networks, or systems for evaluating independently submitted code.
  • Exposure to Rust, native Python extensions, or WebAssembly.
  • An interest in scientific research, open-source software, and tools that make research easier to inspect and reuse.

You don't need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly across the stack matter most.

What success looks like

  • You can independently deliver scoped features and fixes across the backend and supporting web applications.
  • Your changes are understandable, tested, and documented, with appropriate attention to security and compatibility.
  • You help make processing pipelines and production services more reliable and easier to troubleshoot.
  • You contribute constructively to reviews, communicate progress and blockers, and help the team turn research ideas into maintainable software.

What we offer

  • $1500 - $2000 per month, depending on experience.
  • Opportunities for rapid professional growth in a high-impact role: a small team, a live network, and a senior engineer to learn from.
  • Quarterly team retreats in inspiring locations (e.g., Vilnius, Koh Samui).
  • Travel and visa support for business needs.
  • Flexible remote working.


Help us build the data layer that lets AI do science properly.

How to apply


Apply online through the link here: https://airtable.com/appZKkV7FT7eYBhKI/shrjJ3jYfxZjsNckR

It takes about 30 minutes: a few practical questions, four short written answers, links to your code, and your CV or personal website. No cover letter needed.

Applications close on Monday 16 November 2026, 23:59 CET.

We read every application after the deadline and reply to everyone.

title: Software Engineer Intern - Robotics Platform
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  


About the role

At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth.

As a robotics platform software engineer intern, you will help build our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will  gather requirements from internal customers, work on communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems.


What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain parts of the robotics platform, e.g. APIs, health monitoring and machine configuration management

  • Contributing to high quality code, improving robustness and maintainability of existing code


    • What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

  • Programming skills in a systems language like C++ or Rust, Python is nice to have

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Infrastructure Engineer, Junior / New Grad (Toronto)
description:
About DataVisor

DataVisor is the world's leading AI-powered Fraud and Risk Platform that delivers the best overall detection coverage in the industry. With an open SaaS platform that supports easy consolidation and enrichment of any data, DataVisor's fraud and anti-money laundering (AML) solutions scale infinitely and enable organizations to act on fast-evolving fraud and money laundering activities in real time. Its patented unsupervised machine learning technology, advanced device intelligence, powerful decision engine, and investigation tools work together to provide significant performance lift from day one. DataVisor's platform is architected to support multiple use cases across different business units flexibly, dramatically lowering total cost of ownership compared to legacy point solutions. DataVisor is recognized as an industry leader and has been adopted by many Fortune 500 companies across the globe.

Our award-winning software platform is powered by a team of world-class experts in big data, machine learning, security, and scalable infrastructure. Our culture is open, positive, collaborative, and results-driven. Come join us!

Role Overview

Join the infrastructure team that runs DataVisor's real-time detection platform and builds the software around it. You will split your time between operating production infrastructure (Kubernetes, AWS, monitoring) and writing code: automation, internal tools and platform services. Senior engineers will mentor you, and you'll take on real production ownership in your first months.

Requirements

What you'll do

  • Deploy and operate services on Kubernetes (EKS) with Helm, and help with upgrades, scaling and troubleshooting.
  • Write and review Terraform for AWS resources.
  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
  • Write Python, Go, Java or Bash tools and services that remove manual operations work.
  • Add metrics, dashboards and alerts in Prometheus and Grafana. Join the on-call rotation once you're ramped up.
  • Help run the data systems behind detection (Kafka, Flink, Spark, ClickHouse, MySQL) and learn how they behave under load.
  • Work with the platform team on features for distributed, real-time systems.

What you'll bring

  • 0-3 years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, platform or backend engineering. Internships, co-ops and substantial projects count.
  • Programming ability in at least one of Python, Go, Java or Bash, and comfort working in Linux.
  • Exposure to containers and Kubernetes (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) at work, in an internship, or in your own projects.
  • Familiarity with a public cloud (AWS preferred) and an interest in infrastructure as code.
  • An understanding of networking basics (DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing) and of how distributed systems fail.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics or a related field, completed or finishing soon.

Nice to have

  • A Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Electronics background, with hands-on hardware, systems or networking knowledge.
  • Terraform, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD) or monitoring tools used in a real setting.
  • Experience with Kafka, Spark or a SQL database beyond coursework.
  • Interest in fraud, risk or payments.
  • Use of AI or LLM tools to automate work.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Annual salary range of CAD $80,000 – $120,000, commensurate with experience.
  • Health Insurance, including (Extended Health Care, Vision Care, and Dental Care)
  • Life Insurance, Accidental Insurance
  • Retirement Savings Plan
  • Paid Vacation

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Netherlands.

Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems.


Accountabilities

You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews.

  • Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.

  • Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously.

  • Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies.

  • Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes.

  • Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance.

  • Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels.

  • Supporting internal stakeholders: Work directly with Operators across business functions to understand their needs, develop requested features, create documentation, deliver enablement sessions, and build self-service tools.

  • Developing reusable AI capabilities: Create and maintain shared skills, plugins, and knowledge resources covering company processes, standards, security requirements, and brand guidelines.

  • Driving process automation: Proactively identify repetitive manual workflows that could benefit from AI, implement automation solutions, measure their impact, and continuously improve them.

  • Taking end-to-end ownership: Write technical specifications, plan and deliver projects independently, communicate progress asynchronously, and remain accountable for monitoring and improving solutions after deployment.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating production-ready AI systems. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and applying sound judgment to complex automation and security challenges. Required qualifications include:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with a solid understanding of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review.

  • Between 6 and 12 months of experience shipping LLM-based systems to production and supporting agentic workflows used by real end users.

  • Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code.

  • Experience developing autonomous or multi-step agents with tool integrations, using technologies such as the Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic APIs, OpenAI APIs, or similar frameworks.

  • Practical experience building MCP servers, including OAuth authentication flows, scoped tokens, and user-level access controls.

  • Knowledge of identity and access management systems such as Okta or similar identity providers, including SSO protocols (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group-based access, and device policies.

  • Experience creating automated system identities, including GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, and managing secrets through tools such as 1Password.

  • Understanding of security guardrails and governance practices, including least-privilege access, audit logging, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code.

  • Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring.

  • Practical experience implementing production observability through tracing, metrics, alerting, and dashboards, using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, or Braintrust.

  • Experience monitoring and controlling AI expenditure across providers through API key limits, cost centers, budgets, and actionable alerts.

  • Strong programming skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.

  • A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical specifications, runbooks, and RFCs.

  • Ability to understand stakeholder needs, translate ambiguous requests into actionable technical requirements, and explain complex concepts to both executives and subject matter experts.

  • A proactive and autonomous working style, with the ability to prioritize effectively, challenge unsafe or low-value requests constructively, and communicate progress across time zones.

  • A strong sense of ownership, including the ability to validate solutions with users, monitor performance after deployment, and continuously iterate.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cryptocurrency, blockchain, payments, or fintech, particularly within regulated or audit-focused environments.

  • Experience creating reusable agent skills, plugins, or shared prompt libraries for organizational use.

  • Familiarity with model gateways such as OpenRouter, LiteLLM, or Portkey, including key management, model routing, and fallback strategies.

  • Experience extending open-source coding agents such as OpenCode or Pi.

  • Awareness of emerging agent identity standards, including MCP enterprise-managed authentication and Okta Cross App Access.

  • Knowledge of context and retrieval engineering, including vector stores, agent memory, and permission-aware retrieval systems.

  • Background in machine learning engineering, including model evaluation, fine-tuning, and model routing.

  • Experience working with agent runtimes and sandbox environments such as Modal, n8n, or containerized infrastructure.

  • Public technical contributions, such as open-source tools, servers, technical articles, or presentations demonstrating experience with production AI agents.

    • Benefits

  • Remote-first work environment: Join a globally distributed workforce and work remotely.

  • Health insurance: Access medical, dental, and vision coverage, with employee and dependent coverage fully provided in certain countries, depending on the applicable plan.

  • Retirement benefits: Benefit from a company-matched 401(k) contribution of up to 3% for eligible employees in the United States.

  • Collaborate directly with the Senior AI & Design Lead for clear ownership, feedback, and iteration.

  • Maintain clear documentation of architecture, decisions, and interfaces for internal teams.

  • (Bonus) Use Convex or similar BaaS / serverless data platforms for rapid product delivery.

  • Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS for production workloads.

  • Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management).

  • Experience building systems in or adjacent to healthcare, education, or compliance-heavy environments is a plus.

  • Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team.

  • Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively.

  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools.

Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A read-only list of available tools (name and category only, no owner details), pulled from Convex.

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • Have two roles:

  • admin:

    • Can remove any listing, view all loans, and mark a lender as “Trusted Lender”.

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

Automation with n8n

  • Build at least two n8n workflows:

  • Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs.

  • Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex.

  • Secure the integration in both directions:

  • Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side.

  • Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON.

  • Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders.

  • Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently.

  • (Bonus) Show recent automation activity on each loan in the app, e.g. “Reminder sent 2 days ago”.

Deliverables

  • A GitHub repository with the app source code.

  • Exported n8n workflow JSON files in the repository.

  • A README covering local setup (including n8n, e.g. a docker-compose file), environment variables, architecture, and your security and data-minimization decisions.

  • A short note on what you would change to run this in production.

We evaluate:

  • Code structure and clarity

  • Security-minded thinking

  • UX and practicality

  • Integration design, reliability, and error handling (n8n)

  • Documentation and reasoning

Interview Process

  1. Take-home assignment submission (as described above).

  2. Technical & product interview (walkthrough of your solution, architecture, security mindset, collaboration style).

  3. 6-month contract offer for the right candidate, with strong potential for renewal as a recurring contract based on performance and ownership.

How to apply

Email your portfolio, GitHub repository, and as an optional bonus, 1-2 other relevant projects to techjobs@fluencetraining.com, along with a short note on a security/privacy consideration you implemented (or would implement) in a healthcare or similar context.
