title: Research Engineer
description:
Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments?
Are you excited by the challenge of turning the classical robotic stacks into the foundational training data for physical AI?
Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution?

If your answers are yes, we should talk.


At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. We believe that physical AI is fundamentally a knowledge transfer problem - we are leveraging the "internet data" of robotics - massive deployment logs from real systems operating in production environments -  to bootstrap our efforts. We are looking for Research Engineers who will help us to build, train, and deploy foundational models that bring our fleet from a classical control stack to generalized AI mastery.


Offer essentials
  • Play with real robots, solving real problems, every day.
  • Relocation package.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • English-speaking environment.

    • Here is why we love this job ourselves, and hope you will enjoy it too:
  • We combine world-class research with top-notch engineering and apply it to solve real problems
  • The data already exists. We have robots in production at scale. We aren't waiting for datasets to be collected; the byproduct of our machines doing useful work is being created right now.
  • We measure what matters. We test our code in unit tests, simulations, and directly on real robots. Grounding our models in deployment allows us to truly measure performance.
  • High leverage, high impact. We’re still a highly focused team. If your training recipes improve our agents, you directly change the economics of the company.
  • World-class peers. Our team has built Google Warsaw, unicorn startups, led research in DeepMind, tested rocket engines, and worked at top companies like Nvidia and ByteDance. Now, we are shaping the reality of Physical AI together.
  • We are building the bridge. We aren't a new startup looking for an application; we are an established player bootstrapping physical AI. We believe that this will be the first true proof-of-concept for scaled physical AI.

    • What you will do
  • Your focus will be defined by the intersection of Robotics and ML and large-scale multimodal model training - expertise in both is optimal and alternatively eagerness to learn.
  • Expect challenges across two main pillars with the opportunity to specialise:
  • Core Research & Large-Scale Infrastructure
  • Own the Training Stack: Design, implement, and maintain the core infrastructure for large-scale VLA model training, including scheduling, distribution, job management, checkpointing, and rigorous logging.
  • Enable Rapid Iteration: Build the critical tools and abstractions necessary for launching, monitoring, debugging, and seamlessly reproducing complex, multi-variant experiments.
  • Train from Deployment Logs: Utilize our massive repository of offline, classical stack data to pre-train robust robot foundation models.
  • Drive the Software Feedback Loop: Translate core research needs into concrete infra capabilities, track experiments, analyze results, and close the loop directly with ML researchers to unblock model progress
  • Real-World Evaluation & Operations
  • Design Physical Benchmarks: Design new robotic tasks and build lightweight physical setups to systematically evaluate model capabilities far beyond the limits of simulation.
  • Execute Structured Evaluations: Ensure robots are properly configured, calibrated, and ready for rollouts. You will coordinate data collection efforts and run structured, on-robot evaluations to measure real-world success rates.
  • Close the Physical Feedback Loop: Analyze real-world evaluation results to guide the ML research direction. You will identify operational bottlenecks across software, hardware, and deployment systems to continuously improve our iteration speed.
  • Scale the Workflows: Beta test internal and third-party tools for teaching robots new skills, and write clear, structured documentation so the broader team can reproduce your workflows and scale your impact.

    • What skills we’d like you to have:

  • Experience: Deep experience and understanding at the intersection of machine learning, systems engineering, and robotics.

  • Proven Track Record: Experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying modern deep learning architectures (Transformers, VLMs or VLAs, Imitation Learning, RL) for robot control, ideally with policies validated on real hardware.

  • Engineering Excellence: Strong software engineering and infrastructure skills. You are highly proficient in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch/JAX) and can write clean, scalable code for training and evaluation.

  • Robotics Intuition: Comfort working hands-on with hardware. You understand the robotics full stack (perception, controls, state estimation) and how to debug failures when software meets the physical world.

  • Pragmatic Research Mindset: You possess the ability to move seamlessly between research and implementation. You prefer execution, iteration speed, and real-world robustness over theoretical purity.

    • What should you expect once you apply?  

    • A phone screen with the hiring manager to discuss your background and our technical direction.
    • A half-day of on-sites (cultural fit & deep-dive technical interviews).
    • A final decision made within 2-3 days after the on-site interview.
    • Important: Expect detailed, honest feedback after completing the process, regardless of our decision.

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

title: Software Engineer AI Tooling
description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

Weâre looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse.

You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What Youâll Be Responsible For

  • Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant.

  • Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production.

  • Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping.

  • Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation.

  • Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works.

  • Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions.

  • Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice.

  • Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it.

  • Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts.

  • Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting.

  • Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

Must have:

  • Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience.

  • Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility.

  • Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype.

  • Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers.

  • Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost.

  • Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences.

  • Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions.

  • Know Postgres and relational database practice.

  • Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector.

  • Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped.

  • Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents.

  • Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates.

  • Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained.

  • Experience across several product surfaces or teams.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what weâre building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environmentâlaptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your familyâs health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. Itâs a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learningâcourses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If itâs in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to supportânot replaceâexisting tools and communities.

description:
Overview

We are building a benchmark that tests how well AI agents handle real expert work in a terminal. We are hiring ML inference and serving experts to turn real, paid tasks from their jobs into expert-level Terminal-Bench challenges. Each task includes the environment, a working solution, and an automated check that proves the result is correct.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

â¢ Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks that turn real, paid ML inference work from your own experience into challenges an AI agent must solve end to end.

â¢ Define the files, systems and environments each task runs on, such as model serving with streaming, so the challenge is realistic, reproducible and command-line solvable.

â¢ Write a working reference solution for every task and verify it runs end to end, sized for about 60 to 75 minutes of expert effort.

â¢ Build automated checks that objectively prove a result is correct, including cases where ML outputs go wrong silently, such as numerical drift or metric bugs.

â¢ Package tasks with Docker and Git so they are reproducible, and document the systems, tools, data and rules involved so reviewers can validate difficulty.

â¢ Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback and agent test runs, adjusting difficulty and fixing ambiguities so each task stays expert-level, fair and objectively gradable.

Skills/Experience

â¢ 3+ years doing ML inference or serving work hands-on (not only studying, selling or managing it), or a PhD plus active research in the subfield

â¢ Did this work in the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used

title: Software Engineer Infrastructure
description:
Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

  • Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

  • Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

  • Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

  • Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

  • Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

  • You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

  • You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

  • You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

title: Research Engineer Privacy and Anonymization
description:
Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
Start Date: ASAP
Languages: English
Team: Engineering

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

About the role

At ClickHouse, we believe in making product decisions grounded in data, not gut feelings. To support that, we've built a comprehensive internal data warehouse — read more about it on our blog. It powers analytics, forecasting, and decision-making across every team in the company.

Our stack centers on ClickHouse as the core storage and processing engine, complemented by dbt, Airflow, S3, AWS, Superset, and GitHub Actions. We ingest data from 30+ distinct external sources, process over 2.5 PB of data, and deliver most data marts to business consumers with a 1-hour end-to-end latency - a standard that demands highly optimized, rock-solid transformation pipelines.

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help evolve the DWH platform, push its technical boundaries, and deliver reliable, high-performance data models to business users across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  1. DWH Platform Development

    • Design and develop reusable Airflow components - operators, connectors, and hooks - along with custom integrations tailored to our data architecture.

    • Build reusable dbt macros and abstractions: incremental strategies, ETL building blocks, and generic data quality tests, all optimized for ClickHouse-specific behavior and our data patterns.

    • Develop DataOps tooling - CI pipelines, data migration frameworks, and security controls - with a strong focus on reliability, self-service usability, and scale.

  2. Team contributions

    • Conduct thorough code reviews for team members and other team contributors.

    • Actively participate in technical and architectural design discussions.

    • Drive technical leadership in specific areas of our stack.

    • Continuously improve the team's development environment, with a focus on automation - including AI-assisted workflows.

    • Contribute to platform stability through proactive troubleshooting and timely incident resolution.

  3. Data modeling

    • Develop, refactor, and optimize business data models in line with our modeling standards and ClickHouse best practices.

    • Mentor and support contributors through code reviews and technical guidance.

    • Lead the design and implementation of the most technically demanding data marts - particularly those involving high data velocity, large volumes, or complex business logic.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Exceptional SQL skills - this is non-negotiable.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Airflow, dbt, and Python.

  • Proven track record building and optimizing large-scale, high-throughput data pipelines.

  • Solid understanding of data warehousing fundamentals: ETL/ELT, dimensional modeling, and data quality.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

  • Comfortable thriving in a fast-paced startup environment — exciting and dynamic, but sometimes wonderfully chaotic.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with ClickHouse - a significant advantage.

  • Familiarity with AWS or other cloud platforms.

  • Experience with CI/CD development, especially using GitHub Actions.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

A fast-growing AI data company is hiring supply chain practitioners to design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks for evaluating AI agents. You will turn real planning work into end-to-end challenges, each with files, a working solution and an automated correctness check. The goal is to build a benchmark grounded in real operations work.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

â¢ Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks by turning a real supply chain task from your work into a challenge an AI agent solves end to end.

â¢ Define the files, data exports and systems each task runs on, such as ERP, MES and WMS extracts, so the scenario reflects realistic planning conditions.

â¢ Write a working solution for each task, for example a 5-day production plan, and confirm it can be solved in 60 to 75 minutes.

â¢ Build the automated check that proves the result is correct, using tests or scripts that accept valid answers and catch planning errors objectively.

â¢ Document the written rules, constraints and SOPs that decide each case, along with realistic edge cases, data inconsistencies and common planner errors from your process.

â¢ Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback, keeping instructions unambiguous, data consistent and the solution and verification reproducible in a command-line environment.

â¢ 3+ years of hands-on supply chain or production planning work (not only studying, selling or managing it), or a PhD with active research in the subfield

â¢ Did the work within the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used

â¢ Personally executed a process where each case is decided by written rules such as SOPs, planning rules or constraints

â¢ Worked inside systems of record (ERP, WMS) and with their exports or reports

â¢ Can describe edge cases, data inconsistencies and common planner errors, and how a mistake would be caught

â¢ Technical fluency in Python or another language and the command line, plus files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

â¢ Available to start around November 4, 2026

Nice-to-have

â¢ Automated or audited the process with scripts, SQL, RPA or rules engines

â¢ 5+ years in the same process family

â¢ Docker, Git and experience writing tests

â¢ Hands-on experience with SAP or other ERPs and TMS/WMS platforms

â¢ Advanced Excel skills

Process

â¢ Task-based engagement paid per task, with each task taking about 60 to 75 minutes

â¢ Vetting task instead of a live interview

description:
Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Saison für Saison entwickeln wir als familiengeführte Unternehmensgruppe erfolgreiche Kollektionen, die inzwischen in über 70 Ländern und 15.000 Schuhgeschäften zu finden sind. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Dass dieses Konzept aufgeht, spiegelt unsere Erfolgsgeschichte wider. Werde Teil dieses Erfolgs und bewirb Dich beim europäischen Marktführer der Branche.

Für unsere Unternehmensgruppe suchen wir im Bereich IT zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Dich als (Junior) AI Application & Platform Engineer (m/w/d).

Digitalisierung, Innovation, Prozesskompetenz, Verlässlichkeit – das ist das Team der Wortmann IT. Hand in Hand arbeiten unsere Softwareentwickler, Projektmanager, Systemadministratoren, sowie Spezialisten für IT-Security, BI & Data Science daran, die Geschäftsprozesse der verschiedenen Unternehmensbereiche bestmöglich durch innovative, reibungslose und stabile Prozesse zu unterstützen. Von unserem eigenentwickelten ERP-System über Standard-Anwendungen bis hin zur Serverlandschaft und unseren Rechenzentren – wir gestalten die digitale Zukunft der Wortmann Gruppe mit Leidenschaft und einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch. Unser Ziel: nachhaltige Digitalisierung, die echten Mehrwert schafft.

Als (Junior) AI Application & Platform Engineer (m/w/d) verantwortest du die technische Umsetzung ausgewählter KI-Vorhaben – von der Bewertung erster Prototypen bis zur Entwicklung und dem Betrieb produktionsreifer Lösungen. Du verbindest Software Engineering, KI-Integration und Plattformverständnis und stellst sicher, dass Anwendungen sicher, skalierbar, wartbar und zuverlässig betrieben werden können.

 

Was Du bei uns bewegst:

  • Du entwickelst Anwendungen, Schnittstellen und Automatisierungen, die KI sinnvoll in unsere Geschäftsprozesse integrieren – von der ersten Idee bis zur produktiven Nutzung.

  • Du erarbeitest gemeinsam mit dem Team und den Fachbereichen passende technische Lösungen und bewertest, wie sich Anforderungen praktisch umsetzen lassen.

  • Du schreibst wartbaren, modularen Code und entwickelst erste Lösungsansätze zu stabilen Anwendungen weiter.

  • Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Team für Qualität und einen zuverlässigen Betrieb: durch Tests, nachvollziehbare Dokumentation, Monitoring und automatisierte Deployments.

  • Du achtest auf einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Daten und setzt passende Sicherheits- und Berechtigungskonzepte um.

  • Du entwickelst unsere KI-Anwendungen und Automatisierungsplattformen weiter und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um Qualität, Leistung und Wirtschaftlichkeit zu verbessern.

Was uns ausmacht:

  • Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit Gestaltungsspielraum, flachen Hierarchien und einer familiären Unternehmenskultur.

  • Alles, was Du zum Arbeiten benötigst: Klimatisierte Büros, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie eine moderne Arbeitsplatzumgebung.

  • Ein Arbeitstag, wie für Dich gemacht: Dank unserer flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle und der Möglichkeit des mobilen Arbeitens kannst Du Dein Berufsleben optimal an Dein Privatleben anpassen.

  • Mit uns profitierst Du von Sonderkonditionen und Angeboten bei verschiedensten Vertragspartnern über das Portal corporate Benefits.

  • Durch einen Mitarbeiterrabatt in unserem Fabrikverkauf sowie im Tamaris Onlineshop füllt sich der Schuhschrank wie von alleine.

  • Niemand tritt gerne auf der Stelle: Durch Schulungen und Seminare fördern wir Deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterbildung, denn Dein Karriereweg ist keine Einbahnstraße.

  • Fit und entspannt im Alltag: Durch verschiedene kostenlose Betriebssportgruppen, eine Kooperation mit lokalen Fitnessstudios sowie mit dem Anbieter sportnavi.de.

  • Wir feiern Erfolg und Gemeinschaft: Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Team-Events und Firmenfeiern sind ein fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmenskultur.



Was Dich ausmacht:

  • Du hast Spaß daran dich mit den Möglichkeiten und Grenzen von KI auseinanderzusetzen und daraus nützliche Anwendungen zu entwickeln.

  • Du programmierst gerne, gehst technischen Fragen gerne auf den Grund und arbeitest Dich mit Neugier und Eigeninitiative in neue Themen ein.

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung mit Python und der Integration von KI-Modellen gesammelt.

  • Du interessierst Dich für CI/CD, Versionsverwaltung, Testing, Deployment, Monitoring und den Betrieb produktionsreifer Anwendungen – idealerweise hast Du bereits erste Erfahrung mit Docker, Kubernetes oder Cloud-Plattformen gesammelt.

  • Du arbeitest gerne in interdisziplinären Teams aus Product Ownern, Fachbereichen, Data Scientists und IT-Spezialisten zusammen.

  • Du kannst technische Gedanken verständlich erklären und kommunizierst sehr sicher auf Deutsch (mind. C1 Niveau) in Wort und Schrift.

Du bist ein verantwortungsbewusster und äußerst engagierter Teamplayer und schätzt die konstruktive Zusammenarbeit? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine aussagefähigen Bewerbungsunterlagen.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

Pleo's Intelligence function covers the full analytical picture - product behaviour, GTM performance, commercial data science, financial reporting, and operational intelligence. The Analytics Engineers who serve these teams own the data modelling layer that all of it runs on: dbt models, metric definitions, and semantic layer contributions that analysts, product teams, and AI tools depend on to get consistent, trustworthy answers.

You'll be embedded in the Product Intelligence team, building the tracking, experimentation, and data modelling foundations that make product data trustworthy and self-serve. You'll join a close-knit team actively migrating our analytics stack onto a new Analytics Warehouse and Omni, moving off legacy tools like Looker and Hippocampus. If you want to build the infrastructure that other people's product decisions run on rather than just report on what exists, this is the opportunity for you.

Who you'll work with and reporting to

You will report to an Analytics Manager leading Product Intelligence and Growth Intelligence. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Product Analysts, and Engineering to get tracking, experimentation, and metric definitions right from the ground up. You'll also engage with the broader Analytics Engineering community across Pleo to drive shared standards, especially around the semantic layer that keeps metrics consistent across the organization.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain dbt models in our new Analytics Warehouse, using a clean, layered architecture and migrating logic off legacy tools as you go.

  • Own tracking plan implementation and QA directly in Segment and Amplitude in close partnership with Product and Engineering.

  • Support experimentation by modelling assignment and outcome data into structured formats that analysts and PMs can query directly.

  • Define and document metrics in our semantic layer, ensuring a single authoritative definition so downstream BI tools and AI applications yield consistent answers.

  • Apply AI-augmented data modelling practices as a standard part of how you write, review, and migrate code.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Analysts to turn one-off questions into durable, reusable data models.

  • Maintain data quality in your domain through dbt tests, freshness SLAs, and proactive monitoring.

What you bring

  • Solid SQL and dbt experience, with a clear comfort owning models end to end.

  • Working knowledge of event-based tracking tools like Segment or Amplitude.

  • Experience with Git-based development workflows, including opening and reviewing pull requests.

  • Clear communication skills to explain data definitions and structures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Genuine day-to-day use of AI tooling as part of your standard coding and workflow routine.

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and untangling legacy logic to build modern foundations.

This role is NOT a good fit if

  • You only want to write dashboards without touching or owning the underlying data models.

  • You require rigid processes and heavy upfront structure before taking initiative.

  • You prefer to avoid data migration, cleanup work, and legacy system refactoring.

Your first 6 months

  • Ramp up: Master our dbt project structure, tracking plans, and migration roadmap while shipping small, reviewed code changes early on.

  • Take ownership: Own a dedicated slice of the migration, such as an event domain or our core experimentation data models.

  • Drive consistency: Establish semantic layer definitions for your domain so analysts and PMs can self-serve accurate metrics without custom workarounds.

Our tech stack context

  • Data warehouse: GCP / BigQuery (new Analytics Warehouse)

  • Transformation: dbt

  • Orchestration: Airflow

  • Tracking and Oroduct Analytics: Segment, Amplitude

  • BI and Analytics: Omni (migrating off legacy Looker and Hippocampus)

  • Languages: SQL

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days—enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office.

  • Comprehensive private healthcare depending on your location (coverage options include Vitality, Alan, or Médis).

  • 25 days of annual holiday plus public holidays, with the option to purchase 5 additional days through salary sacrifice.

  • Flexible working options supporting both hybrid and fully remote setups.

  • Free mental health and well-being support through MyndUp.

  • Generous paid parental leave policies to support growing families.

The interview process

  1. Intro Call: 30 minutes with our Talent Partner

  2. SQL Test: Completed via CoderPad

  3. Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes with our Data & Analytics Manager

  4. Team Interview & Live Case: Data modelling case via CodeSignal

  5. Final Interview: 30 minutes with our VP of Data & AI

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired an Analytics Engineer, we received a total of 173 applications but only 10 were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: it was very clear that many of the CVs we saw were very generic and AI generated. There is no issue with leveraging AI to help with CV writing, there was little indication of what real impact the candidates had in their previous experience. You might have heard of the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit Laszlo Bock ~2014), this is a great way to give a clear picture of what you have actually worked on. Some link or quick description of the companies you’ve worked with is also a great help.

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: there was misunderstanding about the type of experience we expect from an Analytics Engineer and we received many applications from candidates who had never been exposed to a product-led environment or had been exclusively focused on SQL/dbt work when we’re looking for both technical and stakeholders management and team collaboration experience. To be perfectly clear, this is NOT a Data Engineer role or a Data Analyst role! This is a heavily-driven dbt modelling role, experience in this area is critical. We’ve taken great care in writing this role description to reflect the reality of the job as best as possible, please ensure you read it carefully and highlight on your CV the experience relevant to what we are looking for.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Cloud Engineer Automation
description:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth. We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! 

 

Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform.

 

At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing  #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday!


Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE!


The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. 

This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice & QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates.
  • Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports
  • Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback.
  • Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved.
  • Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO.
  • Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches.
  • Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling.
  • Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained.
  • Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. 
  • Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code.
  • Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work
  • Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library.
  • Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them.
  • Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it.


Requirements:
  • 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production.
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. 
  • Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). 
  • Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring.
  • Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS.
  • Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce.
  • Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes
  • Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset.
  • Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts.
  • A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation.
  • FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. 
  • Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. 
  • Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. 
  • Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 


\n
$120,000 - $140,000 a year
\n

Smile discloses that artificial intelligence (AI) may be used in portions of the recruitment and selection process, such as resume screening or application assessment. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by qualified human decision-makers, and AI tools are used to support â not replace â fair and equitable hiring practices. 

 

This position is a new role, created to support Smileâs continued growth and commitment to operational excellence.


Some of the benefits we offer:

* Remote Work Environment

* Flexible Time Away From Work Policy including PTO, Personal and Sick Days

* Competitive Salary and Health/Medical Benefits

* RRSP/TFSA/401K Employee Contribution

* Life and Disability

* Employee Assistance Program

* FHIR Study Program and Skillsoft Learning

* Super HAPI Fun Club


Smile's core values include respect, inclusion, embracing our differences, and celebrating shared values because our people are the foundation of our success. We are big on creating a sense of belonging and empowering each other to bring our authentic selves to work.  We are dedicated to fostering a workplace that values diversity, equity, and inclusion.

 

We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Candidates are encouraged to inform us if they wish to discuss or require accommodations during interviews or while working at Smile.

title: Cloud Engineer (Generative AI & LLM) (m/w/d)
description:
Willkommen bei CBTW! Wir sind ein innovatives Team mit über 3.000 Mitarbeitern in 21 Ländern und führend in den Bereichen Strategie & Governance, Software-Engineering, Datenanalyse & KI und mehr.

Als Mitglied unseres Teams bei CBTW arbeitest Du in einem inspirierenden Umfeld an anspruchsvollen Projekten. Wir fördern die Entwicklung der Experten von morgen und schätzen Deine Ideen. Wenn Du bereit bist, die Zukunft der datengetriebenen Transformation mit einem hochmotivierten Team zu gestalten, bewirb Dich jetzt bei CBTW! Zusammen schaffen wir Großartiges.

Aufgaben

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen und engagierten Cloud Engineer (Medior–Senior) mit Schwerpunkt auf generativer KI zur Verstärkung unseres Teams. In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du eine zentrale Verantwortung für den Aufbau, die Weiterentwicklung und den stabilen Betrieb skalierbarer Cloud-Infrastrukturen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden leistungsfähige KI-gestützte Lösungen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Eigenverantwortliche Entwicklung, Bereitstellung und Betrieb skalierbarer Cloud-Architekturen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams und Kunden zur Integration generativer KI-Modelle in produktive Cloud-Lösungen

  • Optimierung von Cloud-Ressourcen hinsichtlich Performance, Kosten, Skalierbarkeit und Security

  • Analyse und nachhaltige Behebung komplexer Infrastruktur- und Performance-Probleme

  • Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung von CI/CD-Pipelines für Cloud-Services und KI-Modelle

  • Technische Beratung von Kunden sowie aktive Mitgestaltung von Architekturentscheidungen

  • Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Best Practices im Bereich Cloud Engineering und Generative AI

Qualifikation

Unsere Anforderungen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung als Cloud Engineer, idealerweise mit Fokus auf Generative AI oder datengetriebene Plattformen

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit mindestens einer großen Cloud-Plattform (AWS, Azure oder Google Cloud) in produktiven Umgebungen

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Containerisierung und Orchestrierung (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Praxiserfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von MLOps-Pipelines sowie im gesamten AI Model Lifecycle Management

  • Solide Kenntnisse im Bereich Data Engineering, Datenpipelines und ETL-Prozesse

  • Erfahrung mit modernen KI-Frameworks und Tools wie Hugging Face, LangChain oder vergleichbaren Technologien

  • Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Herausforderungen strukturiert zu analysieren und nachhaltig zu lösen

  • Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – auch in der Abstimmung mit Kunden und Stakeholdern

  • Teamplayer-Mindset und Erfahrung in interdisziplinären Projektteams

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der DACH Region

  • Gehaltsspanne für diese Position (Medior-Level): 65.000 € – 75.000 € brutto/Jahr. Die finale Einstufung erfolgt abhängig von Erfahrung und Skillset

title: Product Engineer KI-first (m/w/d) - Full Stack, 100 % remote
description:
In unserem Portal bereiten mittelständische Unternehmen ihren Antrag bei der Bescheinigungsstelle Forschungszulage vor. Sie erfassen dort Projektzeiten und Kosten, laden ihre Unterlagen hoch und arbeiten mit unseren Beratern aus ihrer Entwicklungsarbeit ein förderfähiges Vorhaben heraus. Das Portal läuft, Mandanten arbeiten damit, und es hat noch viel vor sich.

Dafür suchen wir die Person, die es verantwortet. Sie haben schon einmal eine produktive Anwendung weitgehend allein getragen und wollen das wieder tun. Sie entscheiden mit, was als Nächstes entsteht, und Sie bauen es: Funktionen, Antragsprozess, Oberfläche, Server und Sicherheitsarchitektur. Dabei arbeiten Sie KI-first. Coding-Agenten sind Ihr erstes Werkzeug und nicht Ihr letztes Wort, denn Sie bauen schnell und beweisen dort, wo es zählt, dass es stimmt.

fundloop unterstützt mittelständische Unternehmen dabei, ihre Forschung und Entwicklung zu finanzieren. Sie arbeiten zu 100 Prozent remote, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und zu den Menschen, die mit Ihrem Werkzeug arbeiten.

Aufgaben

Sie entwickeln unser Portal eigenverantwortlich weiter, von der Idee bis zum Betrieb. Im Einzelnen heißt das:

  • Funktionen bauen, die Mandate voranbringen: Sie nehmen auf, woran Berater und Mandanten hängen bleiben, entscheiden mit uns über die Reihenfolge und liefern in kurzen Zyklen aus.

  • Den Antragsprozess weiterentwickeln: Der Weg vom Mandantengespräch bis zum fertigen Antragsentwurf ist bei uns ein geführter, KI-gestützter Ablauf mit fachlichen Prüfschritten. Sie machen ihn treffsicherer und schneller und sorgen dafür, dass er auch bei vielen parallelen Mandaten trägt. Das fachliche Urteil bleibt bei unseren Beratern.

  • Mit Sprachmodellen arbeiten, im Portal und beim Bauen: Sie gestalten Prompts, Agenten und Prüfläufe und messen, ob ein Schritt wirklich besser geworden ist.

  • Die Sicherheitsarchitektur verantworten: Mandantentrennung auf Datenbankebene, Rollen und Rechte, Verschlüsselung, Zwei-Faktor-Anmeldung und Protokollierung. Unsere Mandanten vertrauen uns Personal- und Finanzdaten an. Vor jeder Auslieferung prüft deshalb ein Test die Mandantentrennung, und Sie bauen diese Beweisführung aus.

  • Server und Betrieb führen: Auslieferung, Testumgebung, Datenbankmigrationen, Backups und Überwachung. Sie halten die Umgebung schlank, nachvollziehbar und wiederherstellbar.

  • Oberfläche und Nutzerführung gestalten: Sie sorgen dafür, dass eine Geschäftsführerin oder ein Entwicklungsleiter ohne Schulung durch das Portal kommt. Ein Design-System gibt es bereits.

  • Datenschutz mitdenken: Sie setzen technische und organisatorische Maßnahmen um und entscheiden bei jedem neuen Dienst mit, ob er zu unseren Anforderungen passt.

Qualifikation

Darauf kommt es an

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen im produktiven Betrieb, in TypeScript und React, am besten mit Next.js. Eine Anwendung haben Sie schon einmal weitgehend allein getragen.

  • PostgreSQL und Zugriffskonzepte als sicheres Fundament. Row Level Security, Rollenmodelle und Migrationen sind für Sie Handwerk, und bei jeder Änderung fragen Sie, wer danach worauf zugreifen kann.

  • Sie arbeiten KI-first, beim Bauen und in der Anwendung. Coding-Agenten sind Ihr tägliches Werkzeug, Sie können ihre Ergebnisse einordnen, prüfen und verwerfen. Außerdem haben Sie schon Abläufe mit Sprachmodellen in eine Anwendung gebaut und wissen, wie man deren Qualität misst.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, da Portal, Anträge und Fachgespräche auf Deutsch stattfinden. Englisch brauchen Sie für Dokumentation und Fachliteratur.

  • Betrieb in eigener Hand: Linux, Docker, Auslieferung und Backups, am besten mit einer Wiederherstellung, die Sie schon einmal wirklich geübt haben. Erfahrung mit Supabase, gern auch im Eigenbetrieb, ist ein Plus.

  • Die Anforderungen der DSGVO an Software, die personenbezogene Daten verarbeitet.

  • Gespür für Nutzerführung. Sie müssen nicht Design studiert haben, aber Sie merken, wenn ein Formular jemanden allein lässt.

  • Lust auf ein Fachthema. Das Forschungszulagengesetz müssen Sie nicht kennen. Sie sollten es aber verstehen wollen, denn die besten Funktionen entstehen dort, wo Sie den Prozess selbst durchdrungen haben.

  • Remote heißt bei uns Vertrauen. Sie setzen Ihre Prioritäten eigenständig und sagen früh, wenn etwas hakt.

Benefits

  • 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Vor Ort sehen wir uns nur gelegentlich, bei uns in Düsseldorf.

  • Unbefristet, in Vollzeit oder vollzeitnaher Teilzeit, Start nach Vereinbarung.

  • Verantwortung für das Ganze. Architektur, Werkzeuge und Reihenfolge entscheiden Sie mit, statt Tickets abzuarbeiten.

  • Werkzeuge, mit denen Sie schnell sind. Aktuelle Modelle und Coding-Agenten gehören bei uns zur Grundausstattung.

  • Kurze Wege. Sie sprechen direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und mit allen, die mit Ihrem Werkzeug arbeiten.

  • Wirkung, die man sieht. Was Sie bauen, kommt kurz darauf in der Arbeit an echten Förderanträgen an.

  • Ein Thema mit Rückenwind. Die Forschungszulage wächst, der Beratungsbedarf im Mittelstand wächst mit.

Wenn Sie lieber ein ganzes Portal verantworten als einen Ausschnitt davon, dann passen Sie zu uns.

So geht es weiter: Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage. Im ersten Gespräch lernen Sie die Geschäftsführung kennen. Im zweiten lösen Sie eine überschaubare Übungsaufgabe, die unserem Alltag nachgebaut ist, mit den Werkzeugen Ihrer Wahl, und zeigen uns Ihren Weg zum Ergebnis. Danach entscheiden wir gemeinsam und zügig.

Arbeitgeber ist die Fundloop GmbH, Fleher Str. 32, 40223 Düsseldorf.

title: Manufacturing Systems Engineer
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.


About the role

We are looking for a manufacturing systems engineer to own the production process and make it ready for a significant scaleup. You will work closely with our engineering and production team in Zürich to make our production more reliable and scalable.


This role is very hands-on and you will spend a lot of your time on the shop floor solving issues and improving production hand in hand with assembly technicians. You will be building out a world class production system to support a rapidly growing supply base.   


What you will do

  • Own how our product is built from start to finish

  • Create and maintain production process documentation, both for internal and external manufacturing

  • Improve workstation layout, flow design and tooling from incoming goods to product shipping

  • Support make vs buy decisions and supplier selection

  • Support new product introduction from development to production

  • Close DFM feedback loop to improve manufacturability


    • What we're looking for

  • A university degree in mechanical, electrical, mechatronics Engineering or equivalent practical experience

  • 3+ years experience in manufacturing / process engineering in mid volume manufacturing

  • Taken a product from prototype to repeatable series production before

  • CAD knowledge for designing fixtures and reviewing designs

  • Solid understanding of mechanical and electrical systems

  • Good command of English, both written and spoken

  • Willing to travel ~20% internationally to support external manufacturing


    • Beneficial experience

  • ERP / MRP Systems

  • BOM management

  • GD&T

  • Python for test automation and production tooling

  • Agentic tools for writing code and automating workflows

    • This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction.

title: Customer Insights Analyst
description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

Role Summary:

The Customer Insights Analyst will transform customer and operational data into clear, actionable insights for our Payer Retrieval business. This role will collect, analyze, and visualize data to identify trends, monitor performance, and help teams better understand customer needs and business outcomes. The analyst will partner with Customer Success, Operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to develop dashboards, respond to business questions, and identify opportunities to improve the customer experience and operational performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collect, clean, and analyze customer and operational data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain Sigma dashboards, recurring reports, and performance summaries that provide visibility into key customer and business metrics.
  • Use SQL to retrieve, combine, and analyze data in support of reporting and business decision-making.
  • Monitor key performance indicators and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for Customer Success, Operations, and business leaders.
  • Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer questions related to customer performance, medical record retrieval, operational outcomes, and business trends.
  • Develop presentations and visual stories that communicate complex findings in a clear and compelling way.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, define reporting requirements, and recommend analytical solutions.
  • Identify inefficiencies, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities through quantitative analysis.
  • Support the evaluation of business initiatives by measuring results and assessing their impact on customer and operational outcomes.
  • Document business requirements, metric definitions, analytical methodologies, and key findings.
  • Validate data accuracy and consistency across dashboards, reports, and analyses.
  • Support the continued development of scalable reporting and customer insights capabilities within the Payer Retrieval business.
  • Other relevant duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in business analysis, customer insights, data analytics, operations analytics, or a related role.
  • Experience working with business intelligence and data visualization tools, including Sigma Computing.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and relational database concepts; familiarity with cloud data warehouses, such as Snowflake.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and develop actionable insights.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
  • Curiosity and a demonstrated ability to learn new business processes, tools, and data sources quickly.
  • Hands-on experience building reports in cloud visualization platforms (Tableau, Power BI).

Desired Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience building reports in Sigma Computing
  • Experience supporting Customer Success, client-facing, or operational teams through data and insights.
  • Experience within healthcare, health technology, payer services, or medical record retrieval.
  • Familiarity with payer operations, risk adjustment, quality programs, or medical record retrieval workflows.
  • Experience developing customer-facing or executive-level reports and presentations.
  • Knowledge of data modeling, metric development, and dashboard design best practices.

We are a medical education and clinical support platform dedicated to empowering healthcare professionals worldwide to deliver the best possible care.

Founded in Germany, AMBOSS has grown to over 600 team members, with offices in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari. Since entering the U.S. medical education market in 2017 with resources for USMLE and shelf exam preparation, AMBOSS has expanded to include point-of-care clinical support and board preparation across multiple specialties. We are now developing a new Qbank for the ABOG Qualifying Examination and are looking for OB-GYN residents and recent residency graduates to help shape this resource.

Position Summary

We are seeking PGY-4 OB-GYN residents or recent graduates for a remote, part-time freelance role developing a new ABOG Qualifying Examination Qbank. You will use your clinical training and board preparation experience to help identify high-yield topics, define what makes a high-quality board-style question, and review questions for exam relevance, difficulty, and educational value. You may also have opportunities to share your insights with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., Commercial, Marketing, AI, Product, and User Research) to help improve medical education and support the responsible use of AI. This role offers a flexible opportunity to explore meaningful nonclinical work alongside your clinical training or practice.

Responsibilities Include

  • Identifying high-yield ABOG exam topics and gaps in Qbank question coverage

  • Helping define what makes a high-quality board-style question

  • Reviewing questions to assess how well they match the ABOG exam in format, content, and difficulty

  • Evaluating whether questions and explanations are clear, concise, and useful for board preparation

  • Suggesting specific changes to improve questions and their educational value

  • Sharing insights from OB-GYN residency training and board preparation with other teams

  • Familiarity with the ABOG Qualifying Examination and OB-GYN board preparation resources

  • Strong clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and written communication skills

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos

In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.
