title: Account Executive - Enterprise I Paris
description:
About us

Procurement is overdue for a reset. For years, procurement and accounting teams have been stuck on legacy platforms that are now trying to bolt AI onto decades-old architecture. The rest of the enterprise tech stack is speeding companies up, and procurement is still slowing them down.

Pivot is the AI-native intake-to-pay platform built to change that. It’s the procurement platform people across the business actually use, so adoption sticks, cycle times drop, and finance sees spend before it’s committed, not after. And because Pivot touches every team in a purchase, accounting teams can finally fully automate their boring tasks.

The adventure started mid-2023 with three founders, former C-levels from fintech unicorns (Qonto, Swile, and Nuxeo).

We’ve built a team of 70 operating across 25+ countries. Backed by $70M from tier-1 investors and trusted by DoorDash, Lemonade, Wolt and Flix, we’ve just moved into the enterprise, and we’re only getting started.


We're looking for smart, execution-driven people who care about building something exceptional.

Your role

As an Account Executive - Enterprise, you will own the full sales cycle for our most strategic accounts on the French and Belgium market. You will target large, complex organisations with multiple stakeholders, navigate sophisticated procurement and legal processes, and close high-value, long-term deals that define Pivot's enterprise footprint in EMEA.

You will join our Sales team, which currently includes a VP of Revenue, Account Executives, a Pre-Sales Engineer, and a BDR team. You will report directly to VP of Revenue.

Your key responsibilities

  • Own complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles from first contact through close, managing procurement, legal, IT, and C-suite stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Develop and execute a territory plan targeting strategic enterprise accounts across your defined region, in close coordination with the BDR team. Willing to open doors by your own methods too.

  • Build and deliver compelling business cases, executive-level presentations, and tailored demos that articulate Pivot's value at every stage of the buying journey.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, structure commercial agreements, and ensure favourable terms for both Pivot and clients, building win-win partnerships designed to last.

title: Sales Engineer - UK
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Sales Engineer to join our team. This is a UK, London based hybrid role, reporting to the Sales Engineering Manager in the Solutions Consulting department. You will act as a pivotal technical partner, presenting the Zscaler cloud security platform to prospective customers and translating complex goals into enticing, relevant recommendations. Your mission is to serve as a trusted advisor, guiding clients through their transformational journeys with deep technical expertise and strategic vision.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Present the Zscaler cloud security platform to prospective customers
  • Set the vision and translate goals into enticing and relevant recommendations
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients while aiding their transformational journey
  • Gather customer technical requirements and promote the value proposition in POV, presentations, and demos

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer or Solutions Consultant
  • Knowledge and practical experience of enterprise network or cloud security technologies
  • Experience working with Value Selling Methodologies as well as collaborating with sales to identify, qualify, and scope opportunities while delivering presentations, demos, and proof of concept engagements

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate AI-generated recommendations and outputs
  • Experience positioning AI-driven threat intelligence, automated policy enforcement, or AI security frameworks to enterprise clients

title: Clinical Research Associate
description:
🔗Are you being referred to one of our roles by a connection in Alira Health? If so, please apply using the referral link emailed to you.

Join our global team dedicated to innovation and initiative, where physical walls and different time zones don’t limit, but encourage, collaboration. Where all contributions and new ideas are explored with an open mind and work is driven by our shared values: be courageous, be accountable, be honest, be inclusive and elevate others.

Job Description Summary

The CRA is an important member of the Alira Health Clinical team. The CRA is highly motivated and functions independently to conduct site monitoring responsibilities for clinical trials; as well as providing oversight, leadership, and guidance in the management and execution of clinical trials to ensure compliance and quality. The CRA works closely with Lead CRAs, Sr CRAs, in-house CRAs, Associate Director of Clinical Monitoring and Project Managers to ensure protocol compliance, address site questions, and assist with study recruitment, site training, and other site-related issues.

Job Description

KEY RESPONSABILITIES

  • Provides guidance, oversight, and feedback to the CRA team to ensure adherence to project scope, SOPs, timelines, and budget requirements.
  • Reviews monitoring visit reports, conducts co-monitoring and evaluation visits as needed.
  • Ensures appropriate and timely investigator site visits.
  • Coordinates with appropriate cross-functional departments to facilitate negotiation/issue resolution for clinical trial monitoring related issues.
  • Assists in development of study-specific Monitoring Plans and training presentations as required.
  • Assists in set up/collection of site specific ethics documents and site contract negotiation as required.
  • Provides monthly billing information to finance team as required.
  • For monitoring stand-alone projects, manages study budget and acts as referent for the sponsor.
  • Performs qualification, initiation, interim, and close-out visits both remotely and onsite, ensuring proper documentation of monitoring visits.
  • Prepares consistently accurate and timely monitoring visit reports documenting site-related problems, resolutions, actions taken, protocol deviations, study progress, and enrollment status.
  • Ensures integrity of CRF data through meticulous and thorough source document review and verification.
  • Performs quality control and verification of documents collected at sites for eTMF/TMF.
  • Conducts investigational product accountability.
  • Reviews site regulatory binder for required documents.
  • Maintains regular contact with study sites to ensure protocol/GCP compliance, assesses patient accrual rates, and responds to sponsor requests.
  • Complies with and ensures team compliance with ICH GCP guidelines, FDA regulations, and company/Sponsor SOPs.
  • Participates in internal, client/sponsor, scientific, and other meetings as required.
  • Facilitates adverse event reporting and ensures the reconciliation of SAE reports with source documentation and CRFs.
  • Works closely with in-house CRAs/CTC and data management to resolve queries on discrepant data.
  • Proactively identifies site issues and develops problem-solving strategies for sites.
  • Conducts audit preparation at study sites as needed.
  • Works with other CRAs to maintain consistency and promote a collaborative team atmosphere.
  • Participates in internal, client/sponsor, scientific, and other meetings as required.
  • Assists in CRA new hire training and onboarding.
  • Performs CRA mentoring.
  • Collaborates with development and maintenance of Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS).
  • Manages and resolves conflicting priorities to deliver on commitments.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.


DESIRED QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Ability to establish and maintain positive relationships with Sponsor, Site and Project Team members
  • Ability to autonomously manage monitoring activities


TECHNICAL COMPETENCES & SOFT SKILLS

  • Quality focused; Proven ability to be careful, thorough, and detail-oriented
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to multi-task and work effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Able to manage priorities, organize time and solve problems
  • Strong analytical, negotiation, meeting management, cross-functional team, and leadership skills
  • Ability to travel
  • Ability to manage stress
  • Professional, trustworthy and disciplined
  • Ability to problem-solve unstructured or ambiguous challenges
  • Strong command of Local language, both written and verbal, in the country where monitoring activities are performed
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with customer service orientation
  • Good computer skills, with ability to use clinical trial management systems, clinical trial databases and electronic data capture
  • Self-starter who thrives in a collaborative, yet less structured team environment
  • Knowledge of clinical research, ICH GCP and local regulations
  • Knowledge of Regulatory and Ethical requirements

Languages

English

Education

Bachelor of Science (BS): Biology, Bachelor of Science (BS): Life Sciences

Contract Type

Regular

Salary Range


The final offer will be determined within the applicable location-specific range and will depend on the candidate’s confirmed work location, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and role scope.

$95,000-$130,000

title: SHIP Medicare Counselor  - Remote
description:
Job Description: Medicare Enrollment Specialist

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote, United States
Time Commitment: 20–30 hours per week, short-term project

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Medicare Enrollment Specialists to help evaluate and improve AI systems focused on Medicare. You will use your Social Security or employer benefits expertise to review questions and ensure AI-generated answers are accurate, clear, and useful. No prior AI experience is required.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Review Medicare enrollment questions for accuracy and real-world relevance.
  2. Create evaluation guidelines covering initial enrollment, Special Enrollment Periods, Part B late penalties, and Social Security benefits.
  3. Assess Medigap, Medicare Advantage, Part D, and employer or retiree coverage scenarios.
  4. Evaluate employer coverage rules, including COBRA, creditable coverage, and primary versus secondary insurance.
  5. Review AI-generated answers and identify errors, omissions, and misconceptions.
  6. Provide clear written feedback to improve AI response quality.

Required Qualifications

  1. Former SSA Medicare enrollment experience or employer benefits/HR experience advising employees on Medicare.
  2. At least 1 year of experience with Medicare enrollment, coverage options, and Part B penalties.
  3. Knowledge of Social Security benefits and employer coverage coordination.
  4. Must be based in the United States.
  5. Available for 20–30 hours per week and able to start quickly.
  6. Strong written communication and attention to detail.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of IRMAA, HSA rules, and working while enrolled in Medicare.
  • Experience creating guides, counseling scripts, or training materials.
  • Experience assisting diverse beneficiaries, including rural and non-English-speaking individuals.

title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization.

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

  • Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice.

  • Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism.

  • Be the go-to expert in one or more domains, such as MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, EKS, VMware, data, security or networking.

  • Help shape our technical offerings and accelerators in line with market and AWS trends.



What you bring:

  • 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and delivering on AWS.

  • A proven track record of leading at least two large-scale cloud migrations end to end.

  • Hands-on database migration experience with MSSQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect â Professional.

  • In-depth knowledge of core AWS services, including:

    • Compute and containers: EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS

    • Storage and databases: S3, RDS, EFS, EBS

    • Networking and integration: VPC, API Gateway, CloudFront, SNS, SQS

    • Security: IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, KMS, AWS Private CA

    • Operations and migration: CloudWatch, AWS Application Migration Service

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code skills. Terraform is preferred; CloudFormation, AWS CDK or Ansible are also welcome.

  • Hands-on experience building and running CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, GitLab, Bitbucket or similar.

  • Experience running containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes or EKS.

  • Strong networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, firewalls and VPN, plus AWS networking services such as VPC, Route 53, ELB and CloudFront.

  • Strong security knowledge: IAM, least privilege, access control, endpoint security and data encryption.

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. You are confident with executives and engineering teams alike.

  • Comfort working in a distributed team, with a few hours of daily overlap with Central European Time.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner-Europe
description:
DeepHealth is seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner based in Europe to own high-impact, full-cycle recruiting across European markets and support global hiring as needed. This is a hands-on execution role in a fast-paced, high-volume environment where searches are varied, specialized, and rarely repeatable. The successful candidate will combine a strong B2B SaaS recruiting background with exceptional organization, proactive sourcing, and strategic hiring manager partnership, developing a deep understanding of each position and delivering tailored hiring strategies. This position contributes to continuous improvement of an evolving global Talent Acquisition function but is not responsible for building or leading the function.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle recruitment across multiple European markets, with additional support for US, Canadian, and APAC hiring as business needs require.

  • Manage a high-volume, diverse portfolio of technical, commercial, product, and corporate requisitions while maintaining quality and responsiveness.

  • Lead detailed intake meetings to understand business objectives, essential competencies, technical requirements, hiring priorities, and candidate profiles for each distinct search.

  • Develop tailored sourcing and assessment strategies for niche and business-critical roles; proactively engage passive candidates through direct sourcing, LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and professional networks.

  • Build trusted relationships with hiring managers, HR Business Partners, and leaders; advise on talent markets, compensation expectations, hiring feasibility, and selection strategy.

  • Challenge and refine role requirements constructively, distinguish must-haves from preferences, and proactively address obstacles to hiring.

  • Coordinate screening, interviewing, feedback, offer development, negotiation, and hiring handoffs while delivering timely, transparent candidate communication.

  • Independently prioritize competing requisitions, manage calendars and deadlines, maintain strong follow-through, and adapt quickly to changing business needs.

  • Maintain accurate ATS records and provide regular reporting on pipeline health, time-to-fill, sourcing effectiveness, bottlenecks, and hiring progress.

  • Use recruiting technology, AI-assisted tools, and appropriate automation to improve sourcing and execution efficiency while preserving sound judgment and human oversight.

  • Ensure hiring activities comply with relevant country-specific employment requirements, GDPR, data privacy standards, and DeepHealth policies.

  • Partner with the global People and Communications teams to strengthen DeepHealth’s employer brand across European markets.

  • Plan and deliver local talent-attraction initiatives, such as recruitment events, university or professional-community partnerships, networking activities and employee referral campaigns.

  • Build relationships with local universities, professional associations and talent communities to develop pipelines for priority roles.

  • Represent DeepHealth professionally and communicate its mission and employer value proposition throughout the candidate journey.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.


Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on full-cycle Talent Acquisition experience, including substantial recruiting experience within B2B SaaS organizations (required).

  • Demonstrated experience recruiting across multiple European countries and navigating differences in talent markets, employment practices, and hiring processes (required).

  • Proven ability to manage a high volume of varied, complex requisitions across multiple job families rather than repeated hiring for a single profile (required).

  • Experience recruiting technical roles such as Software Engineering, Cloud/DevOps, Product, Data Science, or AI/ML, alongside commercial or corporate functions (required).

  • Strong direct sourcing capability, including passive candidate engagement and role-specific market mapping (required).

  • Demonstrated ability to build strategic relationships with hiring managers and senior stakeholders, advise on hiring strategy, and influence decisions (required).

  • Exceptional time management, prioritization, organization, communication, and attention to detail (required).

  • Experience with applicant tracking systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, recruiting metrics, and modern sourcing tools (required).

  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English and ability to collaborate across international time zones (required).

  • Experience developing employer-brand activity or delivering local talent-attraction initiatives, such as recruitment events, university partnerships, professional-community engagement or employee advocacy (preferred).

  • Experience recruiting into the United States, Canada, and APAC (preferred).

  • Experience in healthcare technology, enterprise imaging, PACS/RIS, radiology software, or clinical AI (preferred).

  • Experience supporting global SaaS organizations, including Employer of Record arrangements, and familiarity with Recruitee or comparable ATS platforms (preferred).

  • Additional European language proficiency (preferred).

Quality Standards

  • Communicates and collaborates professionally with colleagues, candidates, hiring managers, and external partners.

  • Demonstrates initiative, integrity, discretion, accountability, and confidentiality in all areas of performance.

  • Follows applicable local, regional, and country employment laws, including data privacy requirements.

  • Follows all DeepHealth policies, procedures, safety, and compliance standards.

  • Adapts to new priorities, tools, systems, and ways of working.

  • Completes responsibilities accurately, efficiently, and within agreed timelines.

This position may require occasional global travel of up to 10%, based on business needs.

Remote (Europe); specific employing country and work arrangement subject to confirmation.

The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

title: Content Creator - YouTube
description:
Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.


Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
  • Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos.


Compensation
  • Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada)
  • Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly
  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits
  • 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays
  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)

title: Strategy & Operations Coach APAC
description:
About The Role

We are looking for senior leaders in strategy & operations roles who value learning, growth, and community and who are passionate about developing and coaching people in their field.

We are specifically looking for coaches who have experience in Singapore or Hong Kong serving the SEA region, or experience in market including Japan, India, South Korea, and Australia.

As a Mento coach, you will form 1:1 partnerships with our members to help them identify & track clear goals, become a better leader, communicate more effectively, problem solve issues at work, and help them feel happy, fulfilled, and engaged at work and beyond.

All Mento coaches, regardless of coaching experience, are required to participate in our ICF-certified coach training program to learn Mentoâs coaching methodology prior to working with our members. Our coach training is an immersive, transformational training designed to help you grow as a coach, master the Mento Coaching Methodology, and gain access to proprietary tools that set our coaches apart. This program is ICF-certified, and participants who successfully graduate will earn Continuing Coach Education Units. If youâre ready to elevate your coaching skills, deepen your impact, and become part of a groundbreaking coaching team, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your journey!

Your routine responsibilities will include:

  • Providing 1:1 coaching to Mento members through virtual sessions using the Mento Platform and Tools

  • Participating in ongoing training sessions to improve coaching abilities and skills

  • Communicating with members via your Mento email or via chat in the Mento App in between sessions

  • Being an integral member of the Mento coaching community by sharing coaching tools and insights â helping enhance our coaching practices and fulfill our mission of empowering people to thrive in jobs that they love

  • Acting with kindness, respect, and empathy as an ambassador of the Mento community

Who are you?

You areâ¦

  • A director, vice president, or other senior strategy & operations leader with 20+ years experience managing strategy & ops teams and coaching individuals (coaching certification is a plus but not required).

  • Someone who wants to turn their people leadership skills into meaningful coaching skills.

  • Passionate about helping people advance in the workplace to build fulfilling careers and lives.

  • A person who is self aware, who has a high emotional IQ, and who cares about creating a safe space for others to risk being vulnerable.

  • Excited about growing your coaching skills, and you bring a growth-mindset to the experience, regardless of how long you have been a coach.

  • Comfortable working in a constantly-changing startup environment.

  • Able to dedicate a minimum of 12+ hours per month to coaching at Mento for the next 24+ months.

At Mento, we invite new coaches to join us on a rolling basis. The time frame on which we add new coaches is based on the particular needs of our clients and their teams. While we may not need to add an Operations & Strategy VP Coach today, we would still be very excited for you to get in touch with us now if this opportunity resonates with you.

Other details

  • This is a contract position in which coaches are paid per hour. On top of a flat hourly rate, we offer select bonuses that incentivizes engagement with our membership and community growth on our platform

  • You must have the capacity to give a minimum of three to five hours per week towards Mento regardless of other commitments and how they may change.

  • You are able to work with Mento for a minimum of 24 months in order to build meaningful relationships with our members.

  • This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be based in North America or Europe.

  • Because this is a part-time growth opportunity, we are looking to hire experienced senior leaders who want to expand their coaching skills.

Our Hiring Philosophy:
All new Mento coaches are required to participate and graduate from our ICF certified coach training program: Mento Coaching 101. This training is rigorous, and our goal is that all participants are able to be matched with members soon after they complete it. We want to make sure that we are both setting our coaches up for success and respecting everyoneâs time. Therefore, we hire based on incoming member demand. While we are constantly looking and interviewing for the best coaches to join our team, we will only send offers to candidates for whom we have an immediate need. Candidates who receive a YES from Mento after the interview process will either be sent an offer to join the next monthly Coaching 101 training or be added to our coach shortlist to join us when the demand is there.

Inclusion Statement:
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Research shows that candidates from unrepresented backgrounds may not apply to jobs unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the requirements.

title: HR Leitung mit Fokus Recruiting (m/w/d)
description:
Jobbeschreibung

Wer sind wir

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 30 High-Performern ist innerhalb von 2 Jahren von 0 auf 1 Mio. € Monatsumsatz gewachsen. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System. Dabei steht und fällt unser Wachstum mit einer Frage: Holen wir die richtigen Menschen ins Team – und erkennen wir früh genug, wenn nicht?

Was für dich drin ist

  • Du führst die gesamte Recruiting-Abteilung und baust die People-Funktion eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens mit auf
  • Du gibst das System vor, andere setzen es um: Dein Recruiting-Team führt aus, unser Sales & HR Analyst liefert die Zahlen
  • Du bist strategischer Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung: Wenn eine Abteilung nicht läuft, sitzt du mit am Tisch und sagst, welche Rolle und welcher Mensch fehlt
  • Echte Perspektive: Du besetzt zunehmend Führungskräfte und Schlüsselpositionen in allen Abteilungen und prägst langfristig, wie wir Führungskräfte entwickeln
  • Verdienst ab 75.000 € p. a. plus leistungsbasiertem Bonus
  • Remote möglich, mit regelmäßiger Präsenz im Office in Hockenheim
  • Investition in dein Skill-Development und 4 Team Events pro Jahr

So sieht dein Job bei uns aus

Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Recruiting-Abteilung und führst das bestehende Team. Du gibst das System vor, also Funnel, Prozesse, SOPs und Kanäle, und entscheidest, wo und wie wir suchen. Für jede Rolle baust du ein Auswahlsystem aus Anforderungsprofilen, Scorecards, strukturierten Interviews, Arbeitsproben, Probetagen, digitalen Assessments und Referenzchecks.

Du besetzt unsere Key-Rollen in Sales und Account Management in hohem Volumen. Dazu kommen zunehmend Führungskräfte, Schlüsselpositionen und Rollen, die es so vorher nicht gab. Diese gewinnst du auch über Active Sourcing und Direktansprache. Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst du die Rollenarchitektur: Scorecards, Stellen-VSLs und Landingpages.

Du kalibrierst alle, die bei uns Interviews führen. Du machst Fehlurteile sichtbar und bringst Gespür und Evidenz zusammen. Die Recruiting-Gespräche deines Teams reviewst du selbst und schlägst Alarm, sobald die Kandidatenqualität sinkt. Mit unserem Sales & HR Analyst verknüpfst du Probezeit und 90-Tage-Performance mit den Auswahldaten. Scheitern Probezeiten oder bleiben Hires hinter den Erwartungen, passt du die Kriterien an. Du sorgst außerdem dafür, dass Bewerber gut über uns sprechen, auch nach einer Absage. Wenn es zählt, bist du vor Ort: bei Probetagen, Starttagen und Quarterly Meetings.

Gemessen wirst du nicht daran, wie viele Menschen du einstellst, sondern daran, wie gut sie sind:

  • Probezeit-Bestehensquote und 90-Tage-Performance deiner Hires
  • Trefferquote deiner Auswahlbewertungen
  • Time-to-Hire und Conversion im Funnel
  • Erfolgreich besetzte Führungs- und Schlüsselrollen
  • Performance deines Teams

Nach 90 Tagen stehen ein dokumentierter Auswahlstandard für unsere Key-Rollen und ein Dashboard zur Qualität der Einstellungen, dem die Geschäftsführung vertraut. Und die ersten Key-Hires sind an Bord.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehr als 4 Jahre Erfahrung im internen Recruiting oder in HR mit klarem Recruiting-Schwerpunkt, davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer führenden Rolle, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden, performance-orientierten Unternehmen
  • Du hast ein Recruiting-Team aufgebaut, geführt und auf Performance gebracht
  • Echtes Gespür für Menschen: Du erkennst den Unterschied zwischen jemandem, der sich gut verkauft, und jemandem, der wirklich liefert
  • Dein Gespür sicherst du mit Struktur ab: Du weißt, welches Werkzeug wann hilft, und kannst jede Entscheidung begründen
  • Sales-Verständnis: Du hast Vertriebsrollen erfolgreich besetzt und kannst präzise erklären, was einen Top-Closer von einem guten Selbstdarsteller unterscheidet
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Besetzung von Teamleads, Heads of und Stabsstellen, auch bei Rollen, die es vorher nicht gab
  • Du baust Systeme, statt nur in ihnen zu arbeiten. Ineffizienzen fallen dir sofort auf, und die Lösung bringst du gleich mit
  • Du gewinnst auch A-Player, die gar nicht suchen, und hältst das Tempo eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens
  • Wenn ein Hire nicht funktioniert, spornt dich das an, statt dass du es erklärst
  • Du gibst der Geschäftsführung eindeutige Empfehlungen, auch wenn sie unbequem sind
  • Recruiting ist für dich Markenarbeit: Jeder Kandidat verlässt den Prozess mit einem guten Gefühl
  • Pluspunkte:
    • Du hast schon eine HR-Abteilung inklusive Mitarbeiterbetreuung und Führungskräfteentwicklung geleitet
    • Du hast eigene Vertriebserfahrung
    • Du kennst High-Volume-Hiring
    • Du hast dich in Eignungsdiagnostik weitergebildet, z. B. mit einem Studium der Wirtschaftspsychologie
    • Du kennst Tools wie TestGorilla, Recruitee oder Close

Du passt eher nicht zu uns, wenn …

  • HR für dich vor allem Verwaltung ist: Verträge, Payroll, Feel-Good. Unser Fokus ist Recruiting
  • du aus der Personalvermittlung kommst und dort vor allem Lebensläufe gesichtet und weitergereicht hast
  • du dich auf dein Bauchgefühl verlässt, ohne es je an Ergebnissen zu überprüfen
  • du als Gatekeeper Prozesse verlangsamst und dich hinter Methodik und Tests versteckst
  • du Modelle und Tests kennst, aber nie selbst eine Abteilung verantwortet hast
  • du lange Freigabeschleifen und große Budgets brauchst, um zu liefern
  • du Bewerber wie Bittsteller behandelst oder dich wichtiger nimmst als die Menschen, die du auswählst
  • du Probleme siehst, aber nicht klar ansprichst
  • Remote für dich Freiheit von Verbindlichkeit bedeutet
  • du einfach nur einen Job suchst und nicht wachsen willst

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich bei uns und werde Teil unseres Teams.

title: Werkstudent*in Produktverantwortung & Projektunterstützung
description:
Du studierst Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder Mechatronik und fragst dich, ob das Gelernte im echten Leben wirklich trägt? In Wedel entstehen Sensoren, auf die sich ganze Maschinen verlassen. Bevor das passiert, muss jeder Test sitzen. Genau dort bist du mittendrin: Du siehst, wie aus Entwürfen belastbare Produkte werden, und sitzt mit am Tisch, wenn Projekte Gestalt annehmen. Neben dem Studium arbeitest du bei uns, mit kurzen Wegen und echten Aufgaben vom ersten Tag an.

Wir bei TWK entwickeln und produzieren seit über 60 Jahren im Wachstumsmarkt der Mess- und Automatisierungstechnik kundenspezifische Sensoren für den Anlagen- und Maschinenbau. Funktionale Sicherheit für Mensch und Maschine ist unser Anspruch – und der lässt sich nicht mit halbgaren Lösungen oder endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen erfüllen.

Wenn du Technik nicht nur studieren, sondern prüfen, testen und mitgestalten willst, dann bewirb dich bei uns in Wedel. Schick uns deine Unterlagen und erzähl uns, woran du gerade tüftelst.

Aufgaben

Damit ein Sensor im Anlagenbau zuverlässig arbeitet, braucht es saubere Prüfungen – und dich an der Seite unserer Projektleitung.

  • Unterstützung der Produktverantwortung und der technischen Projektleitung im Tagesgeschäft

  • Mitarbeit bei Terminplanung, Abstimmungen und Meilensteinen

  • Pflege und Aktualisierung aller relevanten Prüfdokumente

  • Dokumentation von Prüfergebnissen nachvollziehbar und sauber aufbereiten

  • Durchführung von Vortests an Sensoren

Qualifikationen

Wenn du Technik nicht nur verstehen, sondern anfassen willst, passt du gut zu uns.

  • Immatrikulation in einem technischen Bachelorstudiengang, z. B. Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder Mechatronik

  • Erste Erfahrungen mit Messtechnik oder Prüfprozessen sind von Vorteil

  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise bei Dokumentation und Tests

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Lust auf Teamarbeit mit Projektleitungen und Fachabteilungen

  • Zeitliche Flexibilität neben dem Studium

  • Eigenständiges Denken und Freude am Lösen technischer Fragen

Benefits

Wir sind ein familiengeführtes Unternehmen, das Wert auf kurze Entscheidungswege und eine “Open-Door-Mentalität“ legt. Unser Team profitiert von einer wertschätzenden Unternehmenskultur, in der die Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf großgeschrieben wird. Neben abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben mit hoher Eigenverantwortung bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden zahlreiche Benefits:

  • Persönliches Mentoring – schneller ankommen, schneller wachsen

  • Option auf Abschlussarbeit und Übernahme – wir denken über den Campus hinaus

  • Firmenevents – vernetzen, feiern, wachsen

  • Firmenfitness über Wellhub – Zugang zu Partner-Studios, Online-Classes und Wellness, flexibel nutzbar.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote-Optionen – damit Studium und Job entspannt zusammenpassen

Bewerbung und Ablauf

Nach Eingang deiner Bewerbung bekommst du innerhalb einer Woche eine Antwort von Christine, Betül oder Alina. Das erste Kennenlerngespräch findet in der Regel online über MS-Teams statt. Im zweiten Schritt laden wir dich meist persönlich zu uns vor Ort ein. Ganz unkompliziert.

Dein Interesse ist geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams. Bei uns erwartet dich ein motiviertes Team, spannende Herausforderungen und die Möglichkeit, dich beruflich weiterzuentwickeln.

Mein Name ist Philipp Achenbach. Seit 2017 baue ich ­zusammen mit ­meinem Team und verschiedenen Universitäten eine der führenden Marken im Bereich ­Nachhaltiges Investment auf. Unser Daily Business ist es, die Welt zu einem besseren Ort zu machen. Um einen noch größeren Beitrag leisten zu können, brauchen wir dich!

Warum wir das tun

Wir sind uns der großen Verantwortung bewusst, die das Thema Geldanlage mit sich bringt. Deshalb setzen wir ein wichtiges Statement: Die Art und Weise sämtlicher Inves­titionen hat Auswirkungen auf die ­Zukunft unseres Planeten, des Klimas und ­folglich auf uns Menschen.

Jeder Einzelne kann mit der Wahl seiner Geldanlage einen positiven Einfluss darauf ausüben.

Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt bei der Vor- und Nachbereitung unserer Vorträge und Podcasts
  • Du erstellst für Privatkunden maßgeschneiderte Geldanlageportfolios
  • Du nimmst aktiv an Kundenterminen teil und unterstützt das Team bei der Beratung
  • Du erledigst die Vor- und Nachbereitung von Kundenterminen
  • Du erweiterst dein Wissen kontinuierlich, zum Beispiel durch unsere regelmäßigen Online Schulungen

Qualifikation

  • mindestens verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse
  • Laufendes Studium der Sozial-, Geisteswissenschaften oder BWL (oder ähnliches)
  • Da teile der Arbeit remote stattfindet können, benötigst du einen PC oder ein Notebook

Diese Stelle ist ideal für dich, wenn:

  • Du Menschen aktiv dabei unterstützen möchtest, einen positiven Beitrag zu leisten
  • Du auf der Suche nach einer Tätigkeit bist, die dich langfristig erfüllt und in der Du Dir auch eine Zusammenarbeit über das Studium hinaus vorstellen kannst
  • Du dafür brennst, den menschlichen CO2-Abdruck zu reduzieren
  • Du dich für die Erhaltung des menschlichen Lebensraumes einsetzen möchtest

Benefits

  • Du wirkst an abwechslungsreichen Projekten in verschiedenen Bereichen mit (Online-Marketing, Ausbildungkonzeption, Entwicklung und Optimierung von Kundenberatungsprozessen)
  • Du arbeitest in einem großen Wachstumsmarkt mit langfristiger Perspektive
  • Du kannst über die Produkte, die du verkaufst, selbst entscheiden (z.B. Versicherungen, Pensionslösungen, Investmentlösungen, Fonds etc.)

title: Mass Timber Field Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
You don't just see timber. You see the future of construction.

The construction industry is changing. Sustainable building solutions, innovative materials and more efficient construction methods are shaping the way we build tomorrow.

You understand the potential of mass timber – and know how to turn that potential into business opportunities.

At Simpson Strong-Tie, we develop solutions that help make buildings safer, stronger and more sustainable. Our expertise in structural solutions, engineering and innovation enables us to support customers in tackling the challenges of modern construction.

To drive the next phase of growth in this exciting market, we are looking for a Mass Timber Field Engineer (m/f/d).

In this role, you will play a key part in expanding our mass timber business across Europe, combining strategic business development, technical expertise and commercial drive. You will connect with key stakeholders across the construction value chain and turn opportunities into long-term business success.

What you can expect

You are more than a sales manager.

You are a business builder, a trusted partner and a driving force behind the development of our mass timber business.

Working closely with our European teams, regional sales colleagues and technical experts, you will help shape our market position, strengthen customer relationships and unlock new opportunities in the growing mass timber sector.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Drive business growth: Execute our mass timber sales strategy and deliver revenue growth by developing new accounts, building a strong project pipeline and converting opportunities into business.

  • Build strategic relationships: Establish and develop long-term partnerships with architects, structural engineers, designers, developers, contractors, engineered wood product (EWP) suppliers and prefabrication companies.

  • Develop market opportunities: Identify target customers, key projects and emerging market trends to strengthen our position in the mass timber industry.

  • Turn opportunities into projects: Engage with stakeholders early in the project lifecycle and drive opportunities from initial contact and technical specification through to commercial conversion.

  • Provide technical-commercial expertise: Support customers through technical presentations, workshops and site visits, demonstrating the value of our solutions, including their technical and sustainability benefits.

  • Be a trusted customer partner: Advise customers on product specifications, certifications and compliance requirements, working closely with our technical experts.

  • Shape our business development strategy: Identify market needs and gaps in our product and service portfolio and translate customer feedback into actionable business opportunities.

  • Work across borders: Collaborate with regional sales teams and European colleagues to develop opportunities and support international mass timber projects.

  • Own your business performance: Manage your sales pipeline, forecasts and KPIs, maintain customer and opportunity data in Salesforce and regularly report on business performance and growth opportunities.

Your primary sales responsibility will cover Germany, Austria and Switzerland (DACH). At the same time, you will contribute to the development of our mass timber business across the European regions defined in our strategy, supporting international projects where relevant stakeholders are based in DACH.

In short: You combine technical understanding, commercial thinking and a passion for developing new markets.

What you bring to the table

You don't need to tick every single box.

What matters most is your ability to understand the construction industry, build strong relationships and turn market potential into measurable business results.

Ideally, you bring:

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in sales, business development or a comparable commercial role, preferably in construction, timber or sustainable building materials.

  • A proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets and successfully developing new business.

  • A strong understanding of the construction value chain and the ability to engage with architects, engineers, developers, contractors and other industry stakeholders.

  • Experience in developing customer relationships, managing complex sales processes and converting projects into commercial success.

  • An analytical mindset with the ability to assess market potential, identify business opportunities and translate insights into action.

  • Experience working in an international or pan-European business environment, with an understanding of different regional market dynamics.

  • A degree or equivalent qualification in architecture, engineering or construction – this technical background is essential for the role.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills in German and English, combined with the confidence to engage and influence stakeholders at different levels.

  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to work independently while collaborating across functions and countries.

  • A willingness to travel extensively (approximately 80%).

Experience in mass timber, engineered wood products (EWP), timber engineering or prefabricated construction would be a strong advantage.

Above all, we are looking for someone who is curious, commercially driven and motivated to help shape the future of sustainable construction.

What you can expect at Simpson Strong-Tie

We are an international company with a clear mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.

But we believe that great results come from more than great products. They come from people who take ownership, share ideas and make things happen.

At Simpson Strong-Tie, you can expect:

Real impact and ownership

You will have the opportunity to shape a growing business area and directly influence our position in the European mass timber market.

A strong international network

You will work with experienced colleagues across Europe, combining local market knowledge with international expertise.

Innovative solutions with purpose

You will be part of an industry that is transforming the way we build – with solutions that contribute to safer, stronger and more sustainable structures.

Room to grow

We encourage initiative, personal development and new ideas. You will have the opportunity to take responsibility and make a real difference.

Ready to shape the future of construction?

If you are passionate about sustainable construction, enjoy developing business opportunities and want to make an impact in a growing market, we would love to hear from you.

Your career path doesn't have to match every point on this list. If you bring the right mindset, experience and motivation, we encourage you to apply.

Content für Kund:innen und für Storytellarr

  • Du schreibst hochperformante LinkedIn-Posts, vor allem für unsere CEO und für unsere Kund:innen.

  • Du gestaltest Visuals im jeweiligen Brand-Design.

  • Du hilfst bei Video-Content, zum Beispiel beim Erstellen von UGC Videos.

Unser Blog

  • Du verantwortest den Aufbau des Storytellarr-Blogs.

  • Du optimierst ihn für KI-Suche (GEO), damit uns auch KI-Agenten finden. Das Know-how dazu lernst du von uns.

Unsere Medienmarke

  • Du bereitest unsere Newsletter mit vor.

  • Du unterstützt bei Videopodcast und Events.

  • Du managst die Community unserer CEO auf LinkedIn aktiv mit.

Unser Creator-Netzwerk

  • Du baust unsere Creator-Datenbank weiter aus. Mit diesen B2B-Creatorn arbeiten wir auf unseren Kundenprojekten.

  • Du recherchierst neue Creator, schreibst sie an und gewinnst sie für unseren Pool.

  • Du baust auch unser B2B UGC Creator Netzwerk weiter aus.

Deine eigene Personal Brand

  • Du baust deine eigene Personal Brand auf LinkedIn oder Instagram auf.

  • Du produzierst Content, der auch unter der Storytellarr-Brand funktioniert, und trittst dabei selbst vor die Kamera.

Backoffice (kleiner Teil)

  • Du hilfst, die Buchhaltung sauber zu halten, etwa indem du Belege den Transaktionen zuordnest.

Was du mitbringst

Wir suchen keine Routine, wir suchen frische Ideen. Du musst Dinge nicht schon hundertmal gemacht haben. Wichtig ist, wie du an Neues herangehst und das du den nötigen Drive mitbringst.

  • Du hast ein Growth-Mindset und richtig Bock, mit KI zu lernen.

  • Du bist hands-on und kommst schnell ins Doing.

  • Wenn etwas unklar ist, löst du das Problem, probierst aus und experimentierst.

  • Du bist proaktiv und denkst selbst an deine Themen, ohne erinnert zu werden.

  • Du hast Lust, unternehmerisch zu denken, vielleicht sogar irgendwann selbst zu gründen, und willst dabei von einer Seriengründerin lernen.

Das brauchst du

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in.

  • Du hast ein Content-Mindset und schon selbst Content erstellt, zum Beispiel auf TikTok oder mit einem eigenen Kanal.

  • Du kannst Geschichten erzählen, ob im Text oder im Video.

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und stehst gern vor der Kamera.

Das ist ein Plus

  • Du hast KI schon in der Content-Erstellung eingesetzt, etwa beim Videoschnitt oder in Canva.

  • Du hast dir eine eigene Reichweite aufgebaut.

  • Du wohnst in Berlin und kannst zu Content-Recordings und Coworking vor Ort sein.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Längeres Interview: Du stellst deine Case Study vor und wir lernen uns besser kennen

Du liest das und denkst: That's me? Dann come to us!

title: Account Executive, Commercial
description:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.
 
As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.
 
More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.
 

The shift to AI-driven software development has fundamentally accelerated code generation. Developers are deploying features up to five times faster, but in doing so, they are ingesting vast networks of third-party open-source components that expose enterprises to machine-speed attacks.

To support this surge in demand, Sonatype is expanding its EMEA Sales team. We are seeking a high-performing, self-motivated Territory Account Executive to join our Velocity closing engine. Moving from a technical BDR or inside sales background into a full-cycle closing position, you will drive fast-paced, high-volume transactions focused on core enterprise cloud opportunities under $75,000.

If you are a self-starter eager to master outbound engagement, continuously invest in your own technical growth, and operate in a high-velocity environment backed by a profitable, category-defining market leader, this is your opportunity to step up and build the next phase of your sales career.

 
 

Responsibilities:

Outbound Pipeline Generation: Independently prospect, cultivate, and engage EMEA accounts to build a predictable pipeline without relying on heavy inbound or channel support.

High-Velocity Deal Execution: Manage a high volume of concurrent sales cycles ranging from 3 weeks to 3 months, taking opportunities from initial qualification to close.

Solution Value Selling: Qualify and present Sonatype’s SaaS/Cloud application security and supply chain platform, tailoring product value to both engineering and security buyers.

Self-Sufficient Deal Management: Run highly efficient sales processes with minimal technical and Sales Engineering resources by leveraging strong technical curiosity, product knowledge, and structured execution.

Forecast & Pipeline Hygiene: Maintain strict accuracy in CRM data, activity tracking, and quarterly revenue forecasting.


Role:

  • Full-Cycle Territory Ownership: Prospect, qualify, advance, and close high-velocity transaction flows within your assigned territory framework.

  • High-Volume Cadence Management: Maintain a high daily volume of outbound touches (calls, emails, social outreach) to uncover latent application security needs inside target agencies.

  • Bid & Proposal Execution: Lead the internal orchestration and timely drafting of technical and commercial responses to public RFIs, RFPs, and agency solicitations.

  • Channel Alliance Alignment: Partner closely with regional channel accounts, systems integrators, and distribution partners to track registrations and secure transactional closure.

  • Value-Based Discovery Demonstrations: Conduct precise technical-commercial discoveries, positioning Sonatype’s automated software supply chain protection as a non-negotiable compliance standard.

  • Forecast Guardrail Maintenance: Protect territory forecasting hygiene through meticulous milestone updates inside our GTM execution platforms.

  • Technical Curiosity & Self-Learning: Proactive mindset with a drive to independently learn software engineering concepts, application security basics, and SaaS/cloud deployment models.

  • Organization & Drive: Highly structured task management skills capable of handling a high volume of concurrent deals and short sales cycles (3 weeks to 3 months).

  • Commercial Awareness: Strong understanding of deal qualification, pipeline hygiene, and value-based closing techniques.

  • AI Readiness: Ability to leverage AI productivity tools (e.g., generative AI for account research, personalized outreach, and workflow automation) with strong judgment and validation habits.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native application architectures, software supply chain concepts, or developer tooling.

  • Familiarity with modern sales tech stacks (Salesforce, Gong, Outreach/Salesloft) and AI-assisted GTM tools.

title: Founder's Office
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for high-ownership generalists to join the Founder's Office for Doit's finance super app expansion. This role is for builders who can take on ambiguous business problems, move fast across functions and help launch new financial products, markets, licences and partnerships.


What You'll Own

  • Drive zero-to-one strategic projects for the finance super app.

  • Support licensing, market entry, partner acquisition, office setup, hiring and operating plans.

  • Research markets, competitors, regulations, partners and business models.

  • Turn founder-level ideas into structured plans, owners, timelines and next actions.

  • Work across product, legal, compliance, finance, hiring, operations and country teams.

  • Build trackers, briefs, memos, operating documents and execution rhythms.

  • Own urgent business problems until they are solved.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong generalist with high ownership, strong writing and sharp business judgement.

  • Able to learn new industries, regulations and markets quickly.

  • Comfortable working on licensing, partnerships, operations, market research and execution.

  • Can turn messy inputs into clear plans and follow-through.

  • Fast, resourceful and calm under pressure.

  • Strong English communication and structured thinking.

  • Experience in startups, consulting, fintech, strategy, operations, investing or founder-led environments is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Finds a way without waiting for a full playbook.

  • Can work with senior leaders and still do hands-on execution.

  • Writes clearly, thinks practically and follows up relentlessly. Handles ambiguity without creating drama.

  • Cares about real outcomes, not looking important.


This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want strategy decks.

  • Candidates who need fixed job scope and predictable tasks.

  • People who avoid follow-up, admin details or operational work.

  • Those who cannot write clearly or move fast.

  • People who want title/status more than responsibility.


Location

This role is based in UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our UK office at least 3 days per week.


Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.


Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: AI Content Specialist
description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 8 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

Team

Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech.

Today, our Creative team makes 10K+ ads a month, mostly by hand. We are rebuilding that process with AI to multiply both our output and our hit rate. The challenge is to produce at massive scale, with quality that holds up.

Role

As an AI Content Producer, you own the production of our ads (Playables, video ads, ASO visuals, statics) and build the AI workflows that let us ship them at scale. You think in systems: you don’t just make creatives, you build the pipelines that scale them.

You will:

  • Produce creatives with AI, end to end: turn briefs into finished ads for the games you cover, from first draft to launch.

  • Design and implement AI workflows: build pipelines that automate variations and repetitive production steps, and roll them out so the whole team can ship more, faster.

  • Own our AI toolbox: test and combine the best tools (Veo, Sora, Kling, Seedance, Runway, Scenario, etc.) and integrate the ones that matter into our production workflows.

  • Learn from performance: analyze results (hook rate, CTR, CVR, IPM) and feed the learnings into the next batches and into the workflows themselves.

  • Bring your own ideas: with your game taste, benchmark competitors, spot trends, and suggest concepts and angles for the games you work on.

 

Profile

  • 1-3 years of experience in a creative, growth, or technical role. We care more about what you’ve built than your title.

  • Very AI-native, with real projects shipped using these tools.

  • Hacker mindset: you automate what’s repetitive and find shortcuts others don’t see.

  • Strong game taste and visual instincts: you know what works on mobile and why.

  • Comfortable with workflows, APIs, or no-code tools. Coding is a plus.

  • Fluent in English and French.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • Remote days on Fridays

title: Mid Market Account Executive - English Speaking
description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

About the Role

As a Mid-Market Account Executive, you'll be responsible for driving growth across one of Prelude’s most strategic segments: mid-sized businesses with high-scale authentication needs. You’ll own the full sales cycle, manage complex evaluations with multiple stakeholders, and partner closely with our technical teams to deliver high-impact solutions.

You’ll help shape our mid-market motion, refine our GTM strategy, and play a meaningful role in expanding Prelude’s footprint across Europe and beyond. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has experience closing mid-market deals and wants to join a fast-growing startup where their impact is immediate and visible.

What will you be doing?

• Owning and managing the sales cycle for mid-market accounts, from outbound prospecting to contract execution.

• Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of high-value prospects across key verticals.

• Leading consultative discovery processes to understand customer needs, technical requirements, and decision criteria.

• Delivering high-quality demos and value-driven pitches tailored to mid-market use cases.

• Navigating multiple stakeholders — from product and engineering to procurement and legal.

• Consistently exceeding quota while maintaining healthy win rates and sales velocity.

• Delivering on cross-sell, up-sell and renewal opportunities

• Sharing insights from customer interactions to help refine product strategy, messaging, and positioning.

• Representing Prelude at industry events, conferences, and on-site customer meetings.

What are we looking for?

• Experience in B2B SaaS sales, including experience closing mid-market deals.

• A strong track record of achieving or exceeding quota.

• Confidence managing multi-stakeholder, multi-step sales processes

• Curiosity - you'll enjoy unpacking how products work under the hood.

• The ability to think strategically about accounts, to identify and engage economic buyers.

• Someone who will thrive in a fast-paced environment, who enjoys taking initiative.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

• Fluency in English

• Enthusiasm for our product and potential

What we offer:

• Competitive salary with uncapped commission and generous BSPCEs.

• Hybrid working style: 4 days in-office, 1 day remote

• High-quality equipment and ergonomic setup.

• Annual company offsite (most recent was in the South of France).

• A close-knit, high-caliber team that prioritizes product excellence and customer success.

• Private healthcare.

• Pension scheme.

• Swile meal vouchers.

Interview Process

• A 30-minute call with our talent team to get to know each other.

• A 30-minute session with someone in the sales team to go deeper into the role.

• On-site interview at our Paris office, including a sales presentation and team meet-and-greet.

• A 1-hour meeting with our CEO to explore our strategy and long-term vision.

description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership

About the Role

As a Mid-Market Account Executive, you'll be responsible for driving growth across one of Prelude’s most strategic segments: mid-sized businesses with high-scale authentication needs. You’ll own the full sales cycle, manage complex evaluations with multiple stakeholders, and partner closely with our technical teams to deliver high-impact solutions.

You’ll help shape our mid-market motion, refine our GTM strategy, and play a meaningful role in expanding Prelude’s footprint across Europe and beyond. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has experience closing mid-market deals and wants to join a fast-growing startup where their impact is immediate and visible.

What will you be doing?

• Owning and managing the sales cycle for mid-market accounts, from outbound prospecting to contract execution.

• Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of high-value prospects across key verticals.

• Leading consultative discovery processes to understand customer needs, technical requirements, and decision criteria.

• Delivering high-quality demos and value-driven pitches tailored to mid-market use cases.

• Navigating multiple stakeholders — from product and engineering to procurement and legal.

• Consistently exceeding quota while maintaining healthy win rates and sales velocity.

• Delivering on cross-sell, up-sell and renewal opportunities

• Sharing insights from customer interactions to help refine product strategy, messaging, and positioning.

• Representing Prelude at industry events, conferences, and on-site customer meetings.

What are we looking for?

• Experience in B2B SaaS sales, including experience closing mid-market deals.

• A strong track record of achieving or exceeding quota.

• Confidence managing multi-stakeholder, multi-step sales processes

• Curiosity - you'll enjoy unpacking how products work under the hood.

• The ability to think strategically about accounts, to identify and engage economic buyers.

• Someone who will thrive in a fast-paced environment, who enjoys taking initiative.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

• Fluency in English and German

• Enthusiasm for our product and potential

What we offer:

• Competitive salary with uncapped commission and generous BSPCEs.

• Hybrid working style: 4 days in-office, 1 day remote

• High-quality equipment and ergonomic setup.

• Annual company offsite (most recent was in the South of France).

• A close-knit, high-caliber team that prioritizes product excellence and customer success.

• Private healthcare.

• Pension scheme.

• Swile meal vouchers.

Interview Process

• A 30-minute call with our talent team to get to know each other.

• A 30-minute session with someone in the sales team to go deeper into the role.

• On-site interview at our Paris office, including a sales presentation and team meet-and-greet.

• A 1-hour meeting with our CEO to explore our strategy and long-term vision.

We care more about potential and drive than perfectly matching every qualification. If you’re excited about this role and want to help shape the future of how companies verify their users, we’d love to hear from you.

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

About the role:
We are looking for a platform engineer / developer experience engineer to improve the systems that help our engineering team move quickly and safely.

This is a hands-on role spanning build systems, CI, testing infrastructure, dependency and vulnerability management, and internal developer tooling. The engineer will combine operational ownership with deeper system improvement: keeping critical processes reliable while identifying and removing recurring sources of friction.

The ideal candidate has strong software engineering fundamentals, excellent debugging instincts, and a genuine interest in building tools and workflows for other engineers. They understand that an internal platform is a product: solutions must be reliable, ergonomic, well documented, and easy to adopt.

Candidates do not need prior ownership of every area in the role. We value broad engineering judgment, curiosity, and demonstrated interest in improving developer productivity over narrow specialization.

Your responsibilities will include:

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have 4+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer or Developer Experience Engineer

  • Are comfortable working with Python tooling and packaging, including dependency management and the broader Python developer ecosystem

  • Have a genuine interest in building tools and processes that help other engineers move faster

  • Have strong software engineering fundamentals and excellent debugging instincts

  • Bring broad engineering judgment and curiosity

  • (Nice to have) Experience with tooling, packaging, and dependency management in JavaScript, Rust, Go or other language ecosystems

What you can look forward to:

  • Location: Office 5min walking distance from Zurich central station, where we primarily work on site

  • Potential for professional growth and advancement within the company

Ownership and ability to impact the company, product, and culture

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.
