description:
Wer wir sind

F& | FOCUS & FLOW ist ein Beratungs-Hub für Transformation und Prozessverbesserung. Wir arbeiten vor allem mit Unternehmen aus dem produzierenden Mittelstand: mit Geschäftsführer:innen und Führungsteams, die ihre Organisation wirksamer aufstellen wollen, ohne sich im Methoden-Dschungel zu verlieren. Daraus entwickeln wir Beratungsprodukte, Trainings und Workshops, vor Ort und virtuell. Unser Anspruch dabei ist, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Gemeinwohl zusammenzudenken.

Unser Team ist klein, die Wege sind kurz. Wer bei uns mitarbeitet, sieht schnell, was die eigene Arbeit bewirkt.

Aufgaben

WAS DICH BEI UNS ERWARTET:

Im Mittelpunkt steht die LinkedIn-Präsenz unseres Geschäftsführers. Er ist das Gesicht von FOCUS & FLOW und für viele unserer Kund:innen der erste Berührungspunkt mit uns. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese Präsenz mit ihm gemeinsam aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du schreibst LinkedIn-Beiträge in seiner Stimme. Dafür lernst du, wie er denkt, argumentiert und formuliert, und triffst seine Tonalität so, dass seine Beiträge nach ihm klingen und nicht nach Marketing.

  • Du entwickelst mit ihm Themen und Formate, planst die Veröffentlichungen und hältst den Redaktionsplan am Laufen.

  • Du baust sein Netzwerk strategisch aus: Du identifizierst relevante Entscheider:innen aus dem Mittelstand, bereitest Vernetzungen vor und behältst im Blick, wer auf seine Inhalte reagiert.

  • Interessante Kontakte übergibst du strukturiert an unser Pre-Sales-Team und stimmst dich eng mit den Kolleg:innen ab. So wird aus Reichweite echtes Geschäft.

  • Du wertest aus, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab.

  • Daneben unterstützt du bei der Unternehmensseite, erstellst Grafiken, Karussells und kurze Videos und arbeitest an Landingpages und Website-Inhalten mit, inklusive Optimierung für Suchmaschinen (SEO) und KI-gestützte Suchsysteme wie ChatGPT, Perplexity oder Google AI Overviews (GEO).

Qualifikation

WAS DU MITBRINGST:

  • Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, ab dem 3. Semester oder im Master, idealerweise in Marketing, Kommunikations- oder Medienwissenschaften, Journalismus, Germanistik, Wirtschaftspsychologie oder einem vergleichbaren Fach.

  • Du schreibst richtig gut. Du kannst dich in andere Menschen hineindenken und ihre Sprache treffen, statt überall deinen eigenen Stil durchzuziehen.

  • Du hast erste Erfahrung mit Copywriting oder Content-Erstellung, ob im Praktikum, im Studium, für einen eigenen Kanal oder im Ehrenamt.

  • LinkedIn kennst du nicht nur als Nutzer:in, sondern hast ein Gespür dafür, was dort im B2B-Bereich funktioniert.

  • Du interessierst dich für Unternehmen und Wirtschaftsthemen und hast keine Scheu, mit Geschäftsführer:innen auf Augenhöhe zu kommunizieren.

  • Du gehst vertraulich mit Informationen um und arbeitest selbstständig und verlässlich.

  • Tools wie Canva, CapCut oder Kenntnisse in SEO/GEO sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Benefits

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN:

  • 10 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, flexibel um Vorlesungen und Prüfungsphasen herum

  • Vollständig remote möglich; unser Büro in Türkheim steht dir offen, wenn du in der Nähe bist

  • Vergütung ab 15 € pro Stunde, je nach Erfahrung und Können

  • MacBook als Arbeitsgerät

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und eine feste Ansprechpartnerin

  • Einblick, wie Vertrieb und Positionierung im B2B-Beratungsgeschäft wirklich funktionieren

  • Teamevents

Eckdaten:

Start: ab sofort

Arbeitsort: remote

Umfang: 10–20 Std./Woche

Befristung: für die Dauer des Studiums

Vergütung: ab 15 € pro Stunde

KLINGT NACH DIR?

Schick uns ein paar Zeilen dazu, was dich an der Stelle reizt, deinen Lebenslauf und zwei, drei Textproben (Posts, Artikel, Blogbeiträge oder Ähnliches). Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

title: Working Student Hardware Engineering & Product Design (m/f/d)
description:
About the role

Modern conflict runs on the electromagnetic spectrum, and the systems that listen to it have to survive the real world. Datacept builds cognitive electronic warfare systems: passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, deployed at ports, stadiums, critical infrastructure, and military sites.

Our systems are already in use with customers. Now the hardware has to scale: produced repeatedly, refined, and trusted in the field.

We are looking for a working student who can take it there: someone who designs the part in CAD and then makes it on the machine.

Your role

You are the hands of our hardware team. You take our existing hardware and develop it into the next generation: robust, manufacturable, well-designed. You work directly with the founders and the engineers, you make design decisions, and you build your own parts in our workshop instead of waiting for someone else to.

What you will do

  • Develop our current hardware into a series-ready next generation: construction, assemblies, tolerances, materials

  • Product design: enclosures, ergonomics, surfaces, mounting, and ease of assembly in the field

  • Create CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials

  • Build prototypes and samples yourself on our in-house CNC mill and 3D printers, plus assembly and functional tests

  • Test hardware under real conditions, learn from failures, and iterate quickly

  • Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturing partners on what works in series production

How we work

  • Build, don't just draw. An idea becomes a part in your hand before it becomes a document.

  • Fast learners over specific backgrounds. We care more about how quickly you pick up new skills than where you have worked before.

  • Intellectual honesty. The right answer matters more than being right. If the test shows the design fails, we change the design.

  • Ownership of outcomes. You organise your own time, focus on what matters, and cut out inefficiencies. Nobody manages your calendar for you.

  • Not building in a vacuum. You stay connected to the founders, the software and RF team, and the sites where our systems run, so that all the pieces fit together in the field.

Requirements

  • You study mechanical engineering, product design, mechatronics, or a similar field

  • You have strong CAD skills (e.g. SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor)

  • You have built real hardware, not only modelled it

  • You have operated a CNC mill, or you are ready to learn it on ours

  • You understand design for manufacturing

  • You go from idea to prototype on your own, and you ask for help when it speeds things up rather than when you are stuck

  • You are available up to 20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks if you want

Helpful, not required

  • Basic CAM knowledge (e.g. Fusion 360 CAM)

  • Experience with FDM or resin 3D printing, turning, sheet metal, or composites

  • Electronics basics: wiring, sensors, integrating PCBs and antennas into enclosures

  • Projects you built yourself: maker work, Formula Student, university teams, a portfolio

  • Rendering and visual design

  • Experience with rugged or outdoor hardware

  • You want to contribute to Europe's technological sovereignty in a domain where it is currently lacking

Benefits

  • Work on a real product that ends up in real deployments

  • Your own workshop with a CNC mill and 3D printers: design a part in the morning, hold it in your hand by the afternoon

  • Flexible hours around lectures and exams

  • Compensation: €16–20 per hour

  • 6-month contract with the option to extend

  • Perspective for a thesis or a long-term role as we grow

  • Insight into real RF hardware and field deployments

  • Workshop and main workplace in Horneburg (R&D). Days without hands-on work can be done from our Hamburg HafenCity HQ

Hiring process

  1. Intro call (15 min, remote): who you are, why Datacept

  2. Project conversation (45 min): bring what you built (CAD, photos, parts), and we start with a small design challenge right away

  3. Final meeting in person at our workshop in Horneburg with the founders

  4. Reference check and offer within 48 hours

About Datacept

Datacept GmbH, founded in Hamburg in 2025, builds cognitive electronic warfare systems for spectrum awareness, counter-drone defence, and the protection of critical infrastructure. Our platform unifies passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, and the RF data infrastructure that ties them together.

title: Music Community Ambassador | First Chair Programme
description:
Help shape the future of music teaching in London

Are you part of London’s music community and passionate about teaching? Join First Chair, Matchspace Music’s founding ambassador programme, and help bring Europe’s leading platform for music educators to musicians across London.

We’re selecting six musicians to help launch Matchspace Music in the UK. You’ll connect with fellow musicians across the city, share what you’re hearing on the ground, and help us understand what independent music teachers need to build and grow their teaching practice.

You won’t be handed a script to promote. You’ll help shape how we arrive in London, from the very first week.

About Matchspace Music

Matchspace Music is Europe’s leading platform for music educators. We help independent music teachers build a professional online presence, get discovered by students, manage their lesson offers and get paid, all in one place.

Founded in Switzerland in 2020, we are home to more than 2,000 qualified teachers across over 100 instruments, with more than 2,100 international teachers registered ahead of our launch. We’re now bringing this to the UK, starting with London.

What you’ll do

As a First Chair ambassador, you’ll:

  • Introduce Matchspace Music to musicians in your peer networks.

  • Start conversations about teaching and the challenges of building an independent teaching practice.

  • Share feedback from your community with the Matchspace Music team.

  • Contribute your own perspective to help shape our UK launch.

  • Work with the team to develop an approach that feels relevant and authentic to London’s music community.

This is a six-month freelance engagement, working remotely for four hours per week, starting immediately. Hours can be planned around your studies or other commitments.

What you’ll bring

We’d like to hear from musicians who:

  • Are actively connected to London’s music community.

  • Care about music teaching and want to help improve how it works.

  • Enjoy meeting people and feel comfortable starting conversations.

  • Can share thoughtful, constructive feedback.

  • Want to help shape how we launch in London.

  • Can commit four hours per week for six months.

A student or recent graduate of a London conservatoire, we’re starting conversations at RAM, RCM, Guildhall and Trinity Laban, and welcome ambitious musicians from across the city, in any discipline: strings, piano, voice, jazz, composition and beyond.

What you’ll get

  • Paid participation: £25 per hour.

  • Flexible scheduling around your studies or other commitments.

  • Direct access to the founder and opportunities to contribute to product discussions.

  • A voice in the UK launch, helping us understand and respond to musicians’ needs.

  • Lasting recognition as a founding ambassador.

  • A dedicated contact: Fanny Chelle, musician, teacher and Customer Success Specialist, who will welcome you and guide you through the programme.

description:
Ready to work somewhere that cares more about how you build software than how fast you can ship it?

At Opencast, we don’t measure developers by the number of tickets you complete. We care about engineering craft, clean design and thoughtful problem-solving. 

 Opencast consultants deliver in complex environments, pairing often and working with others who take pride in doing things properly: TDD, emerging design, refactoring and leaving code better than they found it. We build software we are proud of, and our clients trust us not just to code but to think, challenge and guide. If you value simple and robust solutions and want a role where your judgment matters as much as your keyboard, you will fit right in.

The role

We’re looking for Contractors in Software Development (consultant level) to help our major clients transform.

Software developers at Opencast care about building products right and combine their own experience and approach with our company values. They are tech agnostic, have expertise in agile methodologies, extreme programming practices and use industry-leading programming languages to deliver agile transformation.

Our approach to software development is collaborative, focused on keeping things simple, and we use test driven development and pair programming as best practice.

Working with clients and key stakeholders is a crucial part of a consultancy role. Our developers are inclusive team players that listen, collaborate, can positively challenge and manage expectations when needed but most of all are always willing to teach and help others. Leaving a client with improved ways of working, working technology and a good experience from discovery through to live is the priority.

Contractors at Opencast follow the same principles as permanent consultants. The roles are varied, technical, and never confined to any one provider or solution.

Requirements

Due to the nature of this role, applicants must either currently hold active Security Check (SC) Clearance or be eligible to obtain it.

Eligibility typically requires UK citizenship and continuous residence in the UK for the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days.

As attendance at client sites is a routine part of the role’s working pattern and involves occasional travel, travel expenses are not covered.

Experience in delivering digital services for the UK government is highly valuable for many of our projects. Therefore, familiarity with the GDS toolkit will be beneficial.

Technical Skills

  • Expertise in Java and/or Scala is required
  • Experience with Javascript, Typescript, Kotlin, Python or Ruby is also valuable
  • Understanding of Object Oriented Programming
  • In depth knowledge of concepts and uses of testing
  • Knowledge or experience of delivering complex services to Government Digital Service (GDS) standards
  • Being comfortable with new technology, t-shaped and comfortable with ongoing learning and development is key to success
  • Experience with agile methodology

A contractor in software development at Opencast is responsible for:

  • Delivering in the upkeep of their team’s backlog
  • Collaborating with the teams testing effort
  • Leading on the implementation of user stories
  • Embracing mobbing and pairing
  • Working with others in a collaborative, multi-disciplinary environment

Salary 

Up to £450 per day (working inside IR35)

Where you’ll work 

This role requires regular on-site attendance across our HQ, hub offices, client sites and home. Applicants must be able to commute to offices and client sites as part of their normal working arrangements, as travel is essential to fulfilling the responsibilities of the role.

We include you 

We welcome candidates from all identities, attributes, ways of thinking and backgrounds to thrive in a career at Opencast. Our aim is for the diversity of our people to be reflected in the solutions we deliver, to help create a fairer society for all.   

Interview 

Interviews will be conducted via Microsoft Teams. We’re happy to make adjustments to support your needs.

Want to know more?  

Visit our website or email

title: Strategy & Operations Associate
description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You'll Own

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions

 

Location

This role is based in UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our UK office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Le.la Customer Success Specialist assure l’accompagnement opérationnel des clients dans l’utilisation des solutions de l’entreprise afin de garantir la qualité de service, la satisfaction client et le bon traitement des demandes utilisateurs.

Support et relation client (Customer Success)

Contribution documentaire

  • Connaissance des outils bureautiques et collaboratifs

Compétences Comportementales

  • Sens du service client

  • Rigueur et organisation

  • Capacité d’adaptation et polyvalence

  • Esprit d’équipe

Niveau d’autonomie et responsabilités

Le.la Customer Success Specialist applique les procédures et priorités définies par la direction.

Ses missions contribuent à l’image de l’entreprise auprès de ses clients, elles ont un impact direct sur la satisfaction client.

Le.La titulaire organise son activité quotidienne dans le cadre des consignes et objectifs fixés.

Les situations complexes ou atypiques sont remontées aux équipes concernées afin de garantir une résolution rapide de la demande client et une expérience client fluide.

Askara est une jeune entreprise qui veut changer le quotidien des dentistes. Notre conviction : un praticien devrait passer son temps avec ses patients, pas derrière son clavier. Notre assistant IA écoute la consultation et rédige pour lui comptes rendus, courriers et documents, directement dans le logiciel qu’il utilise déjà. Moins d’administratif, plus de soin.

Nous sommes une équipe à taille humaine, motivée, qui avance vite. Le produit évolue en permanence (une nouvelle version vient d’ailleurs de sortir), et les retours terrain remontés par le Care pèsent directement sur ce que nous construisons.

Vous rejoindrez le pôle Care, déjà composé de 3 personnes qui connaissent le produit et les praticiens par cœur. Vous ne serez donc pas seul·e. Vous aurez une équipe pour vous former, vous épauler et partager les bonnes pratiques, avec de vraies marges pour proposer des améliorations. Vous serez au contact direct des dentistes, au téléphone, en formation ou sur les congrès, et vous verrez concrètement l’impact de votre travail sur leur quotidien.

What your day-to-day work will involve

As an Account Manager, you will develop the French seller market and act as the main point of contact for new and existing sellers. You will build a profitable portfolio, develop long-term relationships based on trust and guide opportunities from the first conversation through to active auction business.

The role combines remote work with regular travel and gives you direct influence on the development of our French market.

You will receive professional support from our teams and work with modern tools that help you structure your pipeline, follow-ups and seller relationships.

What this means in practice

  • Identify, approach and acquire new sellers in the French market.
  • Develop a profitable seller portfolio and build long-term relationships based on trust.
  • Research companies and market opportunities and turn them into relevant conversations.
  • Present our activities and value proposition clearly to business owners and potential sellers.
  • Prepare meetings, understand seller needs and agree on clear next steps.
  • Own negotiations and follow opportunities through to conversion.
  • Keep pipeline, follow-ups and seller information structured with modern tools.
  • Represent our company image and values in the market and coordinate closely with internal teams.
What matters in this role

We are looking for someone who enjoys building a market rather than only maintaining an existing portfolio. You should be comfortable creating your own pipeline, speaking confidently with business owners, handling rejection and staying focused until opportunities move forward.

What you should bring

  • Proven experience in sales, business development or new-business acquisition.
  • Experience in a technical, industrial or B2B environment with measurable commercial results.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, closing and relationship-building skills.
  • Autonomy, commercial drive, persistence and a results-oriented approach.
  • Willingness to travel regularly and a valid Category B driving licence.
  • French as a native language and the ability to work in English.

A perfect CV is less important than your ability to create relationships, develop a territory and turn commercial opportunities into long-term seller business.

What we offer

Autonomy with professional support

You will own your territory and your seller relationships while working closely with internal teams that support you with expertise, coordination and operational follow-through. You will not be left alone with complex opportunities or process questions.

Build something with visible impact

The role gives you the opportunity to help establish the French market, shape long-term seller relationships and contribute directly to recurring auction activity. Your work combines commercial ownership with professional development.

Performance that pays off

You can expect an attractive compensation package with a competitive fixed salary and a bonus model that recognises your individual performance.

Your benefits

Company car, computer, phone and meal tickets support you in your day-to-day work.

Do you have a track record in B2B sales and want to help build the French seller market? We look forward to hearing from you.

For this position we source for our sistercompany Troostwijk.

About us

Troostwijk and it's group TBAuctions are one of Europe’s leading networks for digital B2B auctions. We market machines, vehicles, equipment and other commercial assets, bringing sellers and buyers together through digital processes and personal support.

What your day-to-day work will involve

As an Account Manager, you will develop the French seller market and act as the main point of contact for new and existing sellers. You will build a profitable portfolio, develop long-term relationships based on trust and guide opportunities from the first conversation through to active auction business.

The role combines remote work with regular travel and gives you direct influence on the development of our French market.

You will receive professional support from our teams and work with modern tools that help you structure your pipeline, follow-ups and seller relationships.

What this means in practice

  • Identify, approach and acquire new sellers in the French market.
  • Develop a profitable seller portfolio and build long-term relationships based on trust.
  • Research companies and market opportunities and turn them into relevant conversations.
  • Present our activities and value proposition clearly to business owners and potential sellers.
  • Prepare meetings, understand seller needs and agree on clear next steps.
  • Own negotiations and follow opportunities through to conversion.
  • Keep pipeline, follow-ups and seller information structured with modern tools.
  • Represent our company image and values in the market and coordinate closely with internal teams.
What matters in this role

We are looking for someone who enjoys building a market rather than only maintaining an existing portfolio. You should be comfortable creating your own pipeline, speaking confidently with business owners, handling rejection and staying focused until opportunities move forward.

What you should bring

  • Proven experience in sales, business development or new-business acquisition.
  • Experience in a technical, industrial or B2B environment with measurable commercial results.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, closing and relationship-building skills.
  • Autonomy, commercial drive, persistence and a results-oriented approach.
  • Willingness to travel regularly and a valid Category B driving licence.
  • French as a native language and the ability to work in English.

A perfect CV is less important than your ability to create relationships, develop a territory and turn commercial opportunities into long-term seller business.

What we offer

Autonomy with professional support

You will own your territory and your seller relationships while working closely with internal teams that support you with expertise, coordination and operational follow-through. You will not be left alone with complex opportunities or process questions.

Build something with visible impact

The role gives you the opportunity to help establish the French market, shape long-term seller relationships and contribute directly to recurring auction activity. Your work combines commercial ownership with professional development.

Performance that pays off

You can expect an attractive compensation package with a competitive fixed salary and a bonus model that recognises your individual performance.

Your benefits

Company car, computer, phone and meal tickets support you in your day-to-day work.

Do you have a track record in B2B sales and want to help build the French seller market? We look forward to hearing from you.

description:
About Our Company:

Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, Cologix is a leading North America network-neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company. Our platform gives customers access to 45+ digital edge and Scalelogix℠ hyperscale edge data centers in 13 markets across the United States and Canada along with a carrier-dense ecosystem of 710+ networks, 360+ cloud providers, 35+ onramps and seven Internet exchanges. We provide our nearly 2,000 customers with direct access to our local operations teams, resulting in strong partnerships enabled by exceptional operational support and unparalleled customer service. Backed by one of the largest North American infrastructure funds, Cologix's experienced leadership team, certified staff and commitment to ESG initiatives help form a culture that values our people, our environment and our clients.

About the Position:

Cologix is searching for a NetSuite Developer to develop, enhance, and support NetSuite customizations and integrations for essential corporate systems. In this position, you will work with a team of developers to deliver reliable, maintainable solutions that support business operations. The ideal candidate has strong SuiteScript and JavaScript skills, applies sound software engineering practices, and can translate business requirements into scalable NetSuite solutions. You will be an integral part of our internal systems software engineering team, contributing to design decisions, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing platform improvements.

What you do daily:

  • Collaborate with a 100% remote North American team
  • Develop and maintain NetSuite customizations, integrations, and automation for internal corporate systems
  • Design and build enhancements that meet business needs while maintaining system integrity, security, scalability, and performance
  • Partner with business stakeholders and fellow engineers to clarify requirements, evaluate options, and deliver practical solutions
  • Apply agile development practices to plan, estimate, deliver, and continuously improve team work
  • Participate in peer code reviews and support consistent engineering standards and best practices
  • Contribute actively in project meetings, raising risks, questions, and improvement opportunities
  • Work with team leads and management to improve development processes, tooling, release practices, and support procedures
  • Troubleshoot application behavior, integration issues, and performance problems; implement durable fixes
  • Consider the full software lifecycle through planning, design, code review, testing, documentation, deployment, and maintenance
  • Maintain clear, current documentation for code, customizations, integrations, processes, and support procedures
  • Focus primarily on development, with limited production support and break/fix work for escalated issues

What makes you a good fit: (Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, including hands-on NetSuite development
  • Strong JavaScript development skills and practical experience with software design, debugging, testing, source control, and release workflows
  • Strong hands-on experience developing with SuiteScript 2.1/2.x; familiarity with legacy SuiteScript 1.0 is a plus
  • Experience with common NetSuite script types, including User Event, Client, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, RESTlet, Suitelet, and Workflow Action scripts
  • Experience building and consuming REST-based integrations, including NetSuite REST web services and/or RESTlets
  • Working knowledge of NetSuite records, saved searches and/or SuiteQL, roles and permissions, script governance, and performance best practices
  • Experience using SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF), SuiteCloud CLI or equivalent deployment tooling, and Git-based source control
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with business stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment
  • NetSuite SuiteCloud Developer certification or other relevant NetSuite certification is a plus

Rush Street Interactive (NYSE: RSI) is a market leader in online casino and sports betting, currently operating real-money gaming with our brands: BetRivers.com, PlaySugarHouse.com, and RushBet.co. We’re building bridges between online, social and land-based gaming businesses to create amazing, integrated experiences that keep players in the game.

As our Product Marketing Intern, you'll get hands-on exposure to how a Product Marketing team supports an online casino and sportsbook, from competitive research and messaging to creative briefing, go-to-market strategy, and cross-team collaboration. This role is designed as a learning-focused, mentored experience: you'll support the Product Marketing Manager and broader team on real initiatives, while developing foundational skills through a structured set of development projects (outlined below). It's a great fit for someone early in their marketing career who is curious, organized, and eager to learn by doing.

What You'll Do:

  • Support Product Marketing Initiatives: Assist the Product Marketing Manager with day-to-day tasks that support brand visibility, user acquisition, engagement, and retention efforts.

  • Support Creative Briefing & Critiques: Help prepare creative briefs, sit in on creative review and critique sessions, and learn how to give and apply constructive creative direction.
  • Learn Go-to-Market (GTM) Fundamentals: Assist in building GTM plans and supporting documentation across core pillars: audience and positioning, messaging, channel plan, timeline, and measurement.

  • Support Data & Reporting: Help pull, organize, and format campaign and performance data; assist in building simple trackers and recaps that inform team decisions.
  • Complete Development Projects: Take ownership of the guided learning projects outlined below, presenting progress and takeaways to the team along the way.

What You'll Bring:

  • Educational Background: Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • Organization: Detail-oriented and able to manage a few small projects or tasks at once.

title: Product & Technical Communications
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

You'll be responsible for:

  • Developing and articulating our long-term vision for the future of human-AI interaction, and what we’re building for developers and businesses.

  • Shaping the narrative around our products (in particular ElevenAgents), connecting our capabilities to emerging needs and trends in the wider world.

  • Leading storytelling and communications for top tier product launches, in partnership with product marketing, and running campaigns between launches to demonstrate the value our platform delivers.

  • Owning our security, privacy, and safety communications, including managing incident responses as part of a cross-functional team.

  • Producing superb written materials that advance our product story – including keynotes, talk tracks, social posts, and press releases – and creating scrappy product demos to show our technology in action.

  • Building the profile of our technical and product leadership, developing novel points of view, and supporting them with media, social, and event appearances.

  • Nurturing relationships with journalists, Substack writers, podcasters, technical creators, and other influencers who shape developer and enterprise buying decisions.

Requirements

We are looking for someone who has:

  • Run product or technical comms at a fast-paced B2B technology company, or built AI / software products.

  • A record of leading significant launches, and running effective product campaigns in between them.

  • Exceptional writing across different formats, with a talent for turning complex, technical topics into sticky narratives.

  • Experience working with security, safety, and engineering teams, and managing incidents.

  • Deep understanding of the independent media landscape and good relationships with some of the most influential commentators.

  • A track record of excellence, be that building products, running superb campaigns, or some other entrepreneurial endeavor.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere on the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT-4 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our New York office.

description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Liechtenstein

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Liechtenstein. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and proactive Admin Assistant to support the financial and operational backbone of a creative, service-driven business. This role plays a critical part in maintaining accuracy across bookkeeping, payroll, inventory tracking, and vendor management while ensuring day-to-day operations remain organized, efficient, and reliable.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role ideal for someone who enjoys working with systems, numbers, documentation, and operational processes. The ideal candidate is highly organized, dependable, and capable of independently managing multiple responsibilities in a remote environment.

You will help create operational clarity by ensuring financial records, inventory systems, vendor relationships, and reporting processes are consistently maintained with precision and professionalism.

Responsibilities

Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

title: Licensed Physician (MD/DO) - Freelance AI Trainer
description:
About the company

Paid per approved task, about $100/hr equivalent. One flat rate for every approved task.

Built to fit around a clinical practice:

  • Tasks estimated at about 10–20 hrs/week while the project is active; you choose when and how much to contribute
  • Contribute anytime, from anywhere
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All reviewers are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for actively practicing physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works ​

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

You decide when and how much to contribute. For this project, tasks are estimated at around 10–20 hours per week during active phases. This is an estimate, not a minimum or a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks are submitted within the project timeline and need to meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Earnings

Earnings are per approved task, at a flat rate set to about $100/hr equivalent based on estimated task time. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the base rate. QA and adjudication tasks are paid at a higher rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved.
  • Incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks. Terms are shared in the project guidelines.

Performance & SEO
